Abstract: Mathematical supervision for language models is typically flattened into isolated problem-solution pairs, discarding the curricular organization and evidential structure of the original sources. We introduce TOME-Math (Textbook-Oriented Mathematical Evidence), a large-scale corpus that converts 2,118 textbooks spanning the core areas of university-level mathematics subjects into approximately 380K structured proof-supervision records while preserving chapter order, proposition-proof links, dependency references, and source provenance. Leveraging these structural signals, we explore curriculum learning across multiple mathematical subjects and characterize scaling patterns with supervision volume and source breadth. At full scale, fine-tuning on TOME-Math raises the unweighted mean score across our held-out evaluations and established public benchmarks by 16.7 percentage points over the base model, while exceeding all three public instruction-data baselines evaluated in aggregate. Our findings highlight structured textbooks as both a scalable source of mathematical supervision and an empirical framework for studying the impact of data organization on mathematical reasoning. We will release the corpus to facilitate further research on structured mathematical supervision.

</details>


### [98] [rTaste: Do Research Agents Have Taste? Evaluating Early Stage Research Judgment](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.40488)
*Art Kanke*

Main category: cs.CL

TL;DR: 研究发现，前沿模型能提出不少有价值的实验，但其排序是否能帮助研究者选出最值得执行的实验，现有证据仍有限。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 研究关注模型是否具备科研判断力：在实验结果尚未知晓时，能否判断哪些实验值得开展，而不只是生成看似合理的实验方案。

Method: 研究让六种前沿模型分析七篇近期自然语言处理论文，并以独立研究代理或团队形式提出最小可行实验、预测实验能否达到模型设定的门槛，并对实验排序。随后，独立执行者尝试全部实验，包括排名靠后的实验；另由三名模型审查者评估结果。

Result: 共评估四百一十五项实验，其中一百九十四项被认为可靠、有价值且具有新意；但其中只有七十三项同时被认为超越种子论文且并非显而易见。代理排在首位的实验比随机选择更常与审查者最重视的实验一致，但并未显示优于直接选择列表中首先写出的实验。模型预测优于基准发生率，却没有可测量地优于同一模型仅依据论文和实验登记信息作出的新预测。团队形式成本更高，整体提案质量没有明确提升。

Conclusion: 模型能够生成大量值得考虑的实验，但目前尚无充分证据表明其排序能可靠改善实验选择。研究提供的评估流程与实验数据可用于进一步检验模型的科研判断能力。

Abstract: Do research agents have taste, the judgment of which experiments are worth running before their outcomes are known? We give six frontier models seven recent NLP papers. Each model, working as a research agent alone or as a team, proposes minimum viable experiments (MVEs), forecasts whether each will pass a threshold it sets and ranks them. A separate executor then attempts every MVE, including those ranked last, and three model auditors judge the results. Of 415 MVEs, 194 are judged sound, valuable and new, but fewer than half of these (73) are also judged beyond the seed paper and non obvious. The agents' first choices match the auditors' most valued experiment more often than a random pick, but are not shown to improve on choosing the experiment written first. Their forecasts beat a base rate but are not measurably more accurate than those of a fresh instance of the same model given only the paper and registrations. Teams cost more without a clear overall improvement in proposal quality. The agents produce many worthwhile experiments, but the evidence that their rankings improve the choice of which to run remains limited. The evaluation harness and a dataset of all 415 MVEs, with their forecasts and audited outcomes, are available at https://github.com/ArtKanke/rTaste.

</details>


### [99] [A Low-Rank Space Captures Linear Alignment Between LLM and Human Neural Activity During Naturalistic Language Listening](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.40511)
*Zach Paris,Emily Finn*

Main category: cs.CL

TL;DR: 研究发现，大语言模型与脑活动的对应关系主要集中在模型表示中一个很小且有结构的子空间；该子空间不同于模型表示中方差最大的方向。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 大语言模型常被用作模拟人类语言加工的计算模型，但其表示中的哪些成分促成了与脑活动的对应，仍不清楚。研究旨在定位这些具有脑预测能力的表示方向，并解释模型与脑活动对齐的具体基础。

Method: 研究采用岭回归降秩回归，从大语言模型表示中识别能够线性预测神经反应的低维子空间。分析覆盖三个自然语言聆听数据集，包含颅内电生理和功能性磁共振成像数据，以及自回归、双向掩码和随机初始化等六种模型条件；并评估子空间在未参与训练的受试者及不同数据集之间的泛化能力。研究还将脑预测方向与主成分分析得到的高方差方向进行比较，并分析子空间中的可解释特征。

Result: 仅使用原始嵌入维度的百分之一至百分之三，即可恢复完整线性编码模型的预测表现。低维子空间能够泛化至未参与训练的受试者，对不同数据集也有一定程度的泛化。相比之下，主成分分析需要更多维度才能达到相同的脑预测效果，说明最能预测神经活动的方向并非模型表示中方差最大的方向。对学习到的子空间进行分析，还揭示了相较于大语言模型表示本身，在神经活动中额外突出的可解释特征。

Conclusion: 大语言模型与脑活动的对齐由其表示中一个紧凑、具有结构且部分共享的子空间支撑，而非由整体表示或主要方差方向均匀驱动。识别并刻画这一子空间，为进一步理解大语言模型为何能够预测脑活动提供了研究框架。

Abstract: Large language models (LLMs) are increasingly used as computational models of human language processing, yet it remains unclear which components of their representations drive alignment with neural activity. Here, we use ridge reduced-rank regression to identify the brain-predictive subspace of LLM representations: the representational directions that support linear prediction of neural responses. Across three naturalistic language-listening datasets spanning intracranial electrophysiology and fMRI, and six model conditions spanning autoregressive, bidirectional masked, and randomly initialized language models, we find that full linear encoding performance can be recovered using only 1-3% of the original embedding dimensionality. These low-dimensional subspaces generalize across held-out participants and, to a lesser extent, across datasets, suggesting that neural predictivity is concentrated in a compact and partially shared representational space. We next compare these brain-predictive directions with the principal axes of variation in the embeddings. Principal component analysis requires substantially more dimensions to recover neural prediction, demonstrating that the directions most useful for predicting neural activity are distinct from those capturing the most overall variance within LLM representations themselves. Finally, characterizing the learned subspaces allows us to surface interpretable features that are overrepresented in neural activity above and beyond the LLM representations. Together, these results show that LLM-brain alignment is supported by a small, structured subset of model representations and provides a framework for better understanding exactly why these representations align. Code can be found at: https://github.com/thefinnlab/low-rank-alignment

</details>


### [100] [How I Aligned Your Model: Scaling Up Multilingual Safety Training with Templates](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.40516)
*Max Neuwinger,Hanna Yukhymenko,Imanol Schlag*

Main category: cs.CL

TL;DR: 论文提出一套基于模板的扩增流程，并发布覆盖六十种语言的安全语料库，用于改善多语言模型的安全训练与评测。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有大型语言模型的安全对齐主要面向英语，多语言和低资源语言代表性不足；公开训练数据规模有限，也较少涵盖各地区特有的有害话题。仅用英语评测，可能无法发现模型在其他语言及文化语境中的安全漏洞。

Method: 研究者从有害提示中提取安全模板，将模板翻译为多种语言，再填入符合当地文化语境的有害或良性实体，规模化生成拒绝与良性语料。经过验证后，形成覆盖六十种语言的多语言安全模板语料库，并用于训练和评测。

Result: 实验显示，英语评测可能高估模型的多语言安全性：一些在英语中失败的攻击，翻译后能够奏效；融入文化本地化内容后，还能发现单纯翻译未暴露的缺陷。使用模板扩增安全训练数据，则可提升对齐数据的多样性与质量，并改善英语以外语言的安全表现。

Conclusion: 多语言安全评测和训练需要同时覆盖语言差异与文化语境。该语料库及其扩增流程为低资源语言和较少代表性文化中的安全研究提供了可扩展资源，但摘要未提供具体性能数值，提升幅度仍需结合完整实验结果判断。

Abstract: Safety alignment for Large Language Models is heavily focused on English with limited multilingual representation, particularly damaging low-resource language performance. Related open training datasets are often limited in size or do not follow region-localized harmful topics to broaden the scope of alignment beyond cultures. We propose a scalable template-based augmentation pipeline to produce massive multilingual refusal and benign corpora, extracting safe templates from harmful prompts, translating them and then filling in the slots with culturally authentic entities, both harmful and benign. As a result, we release MSafeTemp, a validated corpus spanning 60 languages useful for multilingual safety alignment and evaluation. Using the dataset, we show that English-only evaluation misjudges multilingual safety: for several models, attacks that fail in English succeed once translated, while culturally localized variants expose further failures that translation alone misses. We also confirm that augmenting safety training data through templates allows for higher diversity and quality of alignment, resulting in improved safety performance beyond English. MSafeTemp and the respective pipeline are aimed at facilitating research and development of safer and more responsible models for less-represented cultures.

</details>


### [101] [IndicIPR-QA: A Benchmark for Extractive Question Answering on Indian IPR Laws](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.40518)
*M. Mohaiminul Islam,Muhammad Abulaish*

Main category: cs.CL

TL;DR: 论文构建了覆盖印度七部知识产权法律的抽取式问答基准，并显示针对法律文本微调的模型远优于词项匹配基线。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 法律问答需要答案准确且能在法规原文中找到依据，但法律语言复杂、资源有限。现有抽取式问答基准缺少覆盖印度全部七部知识产权法、并提供精确答案片段的数据集，限制了相关模型的训练与评估。

Method: 作者提出印度知识产权法律问答基准，包含来自七部法律、1116段法规文本的4462组问答。问答由生成式模型生成，并经九项自动质量检查、单模型与多模型评估，以及200组人工抽查验证。数据按法规章节划分训练、验证和测试集，以避免不同集合共享原文上下文；此外还分析答案长度、词汇重合度及多分句结构。基线比较采用统一的滑动窗口推理方案。

Result: 词项匹配基线的词元级F1为20.21，微调后的法律领域模型InLegalBERT达到85.02，表明单纯词面匹配难以处理此类法律问答。七部法律之间的表现也存在差异，说明不同法规的答案抽取难度并不一致。

Conclusion: 该基准为印度知识产权法律中的精确答案片段抽取提供了系统化评测资源。实验显示，领域适配显著提升问答表现；跨法律的性能差异则提示，后续研究仍需关注法规文本结构及不同法律的特定挑战。

Abstract: Legal Question Answering (QA) over statutory texts is a challenging task in Natural Language Processing (NLP), especially in low-resource settings with complex legal systems. It requires answers that are precise and grounded in the law. However, to the best of current knowledge, no existing extractive QA benchmark provides exact answer spans from statutory texts across all seven Indian Intellectual Property Rights (IPR) Acts. This paper presents IndicIPR-QA1, an extractive QA benchmark for Indian IPR laws. The proposed dataset contains 4,462 QA pairs from 1,116 statutory contexts across seven Acts. Questions and answers are generated using GPT-4o and validated through nine automatic quality checks, single and multi-model LLM evaluations, and a 200-pair human audit. Section-level partitioning prevents source-context overlap across the training, validation, and test sets. Further analysis examines answer span length, lexical overlap, and multi-clause structure across the corpus and individual Acts. BM25 achieves a token-level F1 score of 20.21, while fine-tuned InLegalBERT reaches 85.02 under a unified sliding-window inference protocol. The large performance gap between BM25 (20.21 F1) and InLegalBERT (85.02 F1) shows that simple word matching is not enough to answer these legal questions. Performance also varies across the seven Acts, indicating substantial differences in answer-extraction performance.

</details>


### [102] [Homebrewed SLMs: Autoregressive and Masked Diffusion Language Models Built at Home for Portuguese](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.40533)
*Pedro Carvalho Brom*

Main category: cs.CL

TL;DR: 本文提供一套可在单张消费级显卡上从零训练小型语言模型的教程与工具，并系统评估其在巴西葡萄牙语文本和联邦法律任务中的表现。结果显示，掩码扩散模型在测试集似然上略优于自回归模型，但差距未达到预注册的最小效应；模型在多项法律任务上表现有限，部分优势只出现在特定文体或评分方式下。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 训练语言模型常被认为需要数据中心级资源，专业领域研究者也缺少判断小模型是否适用于特定任务的可靠基准。本文旨在展示低成本从零训练的可行性，并通过预先登记的比较方案、法律任务和公开参照模型，揭示模型实际能力与局限，而非提出新的建模方法。

Method: 作者发布经过测试的软件包和两份巴西葡萄牙语教程笔记，在单张消费级显卡上从零训练约一千一百万至一千二百万参数的模型，包含分词器训练。自回归生成与掩码扩散生成使用同一网络。评测涵盖巴西散文和联邦法律，并以克内瑟—内伊平滑六元语法模型作为基线；法律任务仅由文本构造，包括似然评估、文本续写、篡改文本检测和交叉引用填空，同时与参数量更大的公开模型比较。比较方案经过预注册。

Result: 训练曲线显示，自回归模型在同一文本上训练六十四轮后达到最佳表现，继续训练便开始记忆文本；掩码扩散模型则持续改善至二百五十六轮。两者最佳测试点的似然差距为每字节零点零六比特，未达到预注册的最小效应。在留出法律文本及训练后发布的法案上，模型的似然表现与六元语法基线相当，但续写这些法案时不及基线。模型在篡改文本检测上胜过基线；交叉引用填空方面，仅在训练中未出现的法令文体中，按题组等权计分时胜过基线及一亿六千万、六亿三千万参数的公开模型；按单题计分时则与最大模型持平。对于法律文本的篡改检测和续写，计算量约为本模型五百至十万倍的公开模型占优。预注册的盲测人工阅读尚未纳入本版本。

Conclusion: 本文证明，单张消费级显卡足以支持从零训练和严谨评测小型领域语言模型，但低训练成本并不意味着模型具备稳定的专业能力。不同训练目标的收益取决于训练轮数和评测任务，局部基准优势也可能受文体及计分方式影响。研究的主要贡献是提供可复现的教程、工具、基准数据与缺陷清单，而不是提出新的算法；其结论仍需结合后续人工评测谨慎解读。

Abstract: Building a language model of one's own no longer requires a data centre. This tutorial trains one from scratch, tokenizer included, on one consumer GPU, and shows how to tell whether it is good for the tasks of a specialist domain. It proposes no new method. It releases a tested Python package and two notebooks in Brazilian Portuguese with autoregressive and masked diffusion generation on one network, a preregistered comparison protocol, legal tasks built from text alone with a Kneser-Ney floor and public yardsticks, reference numbers for models of 11 to 12M parameters, and a catalogue of defects that only measurement revealed. On Brazilian prose and federal laws, at minutes per run, the autoregressive mode peaks at 64 epochs over the same text and then memorises it, while masked diffusion improves up to 256. At their best points on test, the diffusion bound exceeds the autoregressive likelihood by 0.06 bits per byte, within the preregistered minimum effect. On held-out laws and on acts published after training, the model ties a 6-gram floor in likelihood on the same windows, and it loses to the floor at continuing those acts. It beats the floor at detecting tampered text, and fills cross-references more often than the floor and public models of 160M and 630M parameters, only in decrees, a genre absent from training, where those scorers stay near or below chance, and in filling the blank only when each group weighs the same, since per item it ties the 630M model. On laws, the public models, trained with about 5x10^2 to 10^5 times its compute, lead in tampered text and continuation. The blind human reading is preregistered and not part of this version.

</details>


### [103] [Every Token Needs Its Own Teacher: Multi-teacher Adaptive On-policy Self-distillation](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.40574)
*Yifu Luo,Chuang Ma,Zeyu Chen,Enkelejda Kasneci,Qi Chen,Gjergji Kasneci*

Main category: cs.CL

TL;DR: 论文提出一种逐词元选择教师的自蒸馏方法，使模型在生成回复时可为每个词元挑选最合适的教师监督信号，并在数学推理实验中取得优于现有方法的表现。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有在线策略自蒸馏方法通常固定教师，或只在不同回复之间调整教师所能看到的参考内容，因而无法处理同一回复中不同词元可能偏好不同教师的问题。试验研究显示，教师偏好确实会随词元变化，且可通过多数投票或基于相对熵散度的选择识别合适教师。

Method: 提出多教师自适应在线策略自蒸馏方法，构建由多个候选教师组成的教师池，并在训练期间针对每个词元自适应选择其偏好的教师，以提供逐词元的监督信号。

Result: 在使用通义千问三系列模型进行的数学推理任务实验中，该方法持续优于既有在线策略自蒸馏方法；相较基础模型，平均性能提升最高达五点九。

Conclusion: 研究表明，在线策略自蒸馏的教师监督应细化到词元层级，而非仅在训练全程或回复层级调整。逐词元自适应选择教师有助于提升数学推理表现。

Abstract: On-policy Self-distillation (OPSD) has proven effective for post-training large language models by constructing a teacher conditioned on privileged references. However, existing approaches keep the teacher fixed either throughout training by consistently exposing it to the full reference, or within each response by adaptively varying partial reference exposure only across responses. In this paper, we argue that neither of them is sufficient. Instead, every token needs its own teacher, as the teacher preference can vary token by token within the same response. Through a teacher-intervention pilot study, we validate that the teacher preference differs across tokens, and reveal that a preferred teacher can be identified for each token through majority voting and KL-based selection. Motivated by these findings, we propose Multi-teacher Adaptive On-policy Self-Distillation (MTA-OPSD), the first token-level adaptive OPSD method. Our method constructs a multi-teacher pool consisting of candidate teachers, and enables every token to adaptively select its preferred teacher during training. Experiments with Qwen3 models on mathematical reasoning tasks show that MTA-OPSD consistently outperforms existing OPSD approaches with an average gain of up to $+5.9$ over the base model, highlighting the importance of adapting teacher supervision at the token level. The code is available at https://github.com/xingzhejun/MTA-OPSD.

</details>


### [104] [PIVOT: Progressive Intervention via Online Teacher Correction](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.40576)
*Zhihao Yang,Boyuan Zheng,Puhui Tan,Yukun Chen,Kuan Zhang,Longze Chen,Jiaming Li,Renke Shan,Lu Wang,Xianpei Han*

Main category: cs.CL

TL;DR: 论文提出一种结合教师轨迹纠正与逐词监督的方法，缓解难推理任务中奖励稀疏、学生难以学到有效策略的问题；在逻辑游戏基准上，八次采样平均准确率从最佳基线的百分之十九点五提升至百分之三十五点六。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 基于可验证奖励的强化学习通常只在完整答案层面获得反馈。对于困难推理任务，如果一组生成结果全部失败，就没有有效学习信号。教师虽能提供指导，但如何让指导既帮助学生找到成功轨迹，又能被学生有效学习，仍是关键问题。

Method: 论文将教师指导分为两种互补机制：轨迹层面的干预，用于提高学生接触到可获奖励轨迹的机会；逐词监督，为学生提供更密集的学习目标。研究发现单独使用任一机制仍可能不足，因此提出一种结合方案：把教师生成的纠正内容插入学生生成轨迹，并在这些片段上施加逐词的相对熵监督，同时保留基于可验证奖励的强化学习目标。论文还系统分析了干预位置与监督方式。

Result: 在困难逻辑游戏和数学推理基准上，该方法持续优于已有方法。在逻辑游戏任务中，八次采样平均准确率由表现最佳的基线方法的百分之十九点五提升至百分之三十五点六，接近翻倍。

Conclusion: 有效利用教师指导需要同时解决两个问题：让学生获得包含成功信号的轨迹，并提供足够密集、可学习的监督。将轨迹纠正与逐词监督结合，能够增强基于可验证奖励的强化学习在困难推理任务上的表现。

Abstract: Reinforcement learning from verifiable rewards (RLVR) is limited by sparse outcome-level feedback on hard reasoning tasks: when all rollouts in a group fail, rewards provide no learning signal. Stronger teachers can provide additional guidance, but this raises a central question: how can such signals be incorporated into RLVR to support successful rollouts while remaining learnable for the student? We distinguish two complementary mechanisms: trajectory-level intervention, which improves access to reward-bearing trajectories, and token-level supervision, which provides dense targets to guide student learning. Our controlled experiments show that either mechanism alone can remain insufficient, motivating their combination. We therefore introduce PIVOT, which inserts teacher-generated corrections into student rollouts and applies token-level KL supervision to these segments alongside the RLVR objective. Beyond their combination, we systematically analyze where to intervene and how to supervise, yielding a recipe for effective guidance. Across hard logic games and mathematical reasoning benchmarks, PIVOT consistently outperforms existing methods, nearly doubling mean avg@8 on logic games from 19.5% for the best-performing baseline to 35.6%.

</details>


### [105] [Multi-View MoE: Letting Every Router Shape Expert Computation](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.40577)
*Zelin Zhao,Tianchi Ma,Junyuan Shang,Shuohuan Wang,Dianhai Yu*

Main category: cs.CL

TL;DR: 论文提出多视图专家混合模型，通过多个路由器改善专家选择，并利用路由偏好调制专家输入；在保持专家计算量与通信开销不变的情况下，提升了下游任务表现。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 稀疏专家混合模型每个词元只激活少量专家，因此专家选择会直接影响模型能力。研究发现，单一路由器的排序与通过密集评估得到的专家效用排序一致性较弱，且在中间层和深层尤为明显。单纯增加选择信号或为多个表示分别运行专家，又会带来额外计算成本。

Method: 提出多视图专家混合模型。其多路由器子模块汇总多个独立初始化路由器的分数，使模型能够选中某一路由器特别偏好、或受到多个路由器共同支持的专家。对于每个选中的专家，模型还依据其跨路由器的相对分数，将学习到的潜在视图混合进专家输入，从而让路由偏好同时用于专家选择和计算调制。每个专家仍只执行一次前向计算。

Result: 在由二百四十亿层、百亿参数且每个词元激活约十亿参数的模型上，使用七千零八十亿词元训练后，完整方法使九项下游任务的平均成绩较基线提高一点一八个百分点。仅使用多路由器时，成绩提高零点六个百分点；路由分数与评估所得专家效用的秩相关性也有所改善，整体相对提升百分之八点一，在单路由器对齐度最低的层中约提升百分之五十八。受控混合实验还表明，模型会利用同时依赖专家和词元的输入差异。

Conclusion: 多路由器能够提供更可靠的专家选择信号，而将这些偏好进一步用于输入视图混合，可在不增加激活专家数量、专家浮点运算量或全互连通信量的前提下提升模型表现。结果支持将路由信息同时用于选择与专家计算调制。

Abstract: Sparse mixture-of-experts (MoE) models expand parameter capacity by activating a small subset of experts per token. Expert selection directly affects model capabilities under a fixed active-expert budget. Dense evaluation of all experts reveals weak agreement between single-router rankings and expert-utility evaluation rankings, especially in middle and deep layers. Richer signals for selection and computation incur additional cost: selection based on internal expert activations requires preliminary computation, while processing multiple full representations separately through the same expert repeats its computation. We propose Multi-View MoE to improve expert selection with multiple routers and reuse their preferences to modulate expert computation under a fixed expert budget. Its Multi-Router submodule aggregates sigmoid scores from independently initialized routers. These routers develop highly differentiated expert preferences during training, allowing experts strongly favored by one router or jointly supported by several routers to be selected. Multi-View further uses each selected expert's relative scores across routers to mix learned latent views into its input, reusing routing preferences for both selection and computation. Each selected expert executes one forward pass, preserving the active-expert count, expert FLOPs, and all-to-all communication volume. On a 24-layer 10B-A1B model trained on 708B tokens, full Multi-View MoE improves the nine-task downstream mean by 1.18 percentage points over the baseline. Multi-Router alone yields a 0.6-percentage-point gain and improves the rank correlation between router scores and evaluated expert utility, with relative increases of 8.1% globally and approximately 58% in the layer with the lowest single-router alignment. Controlled mixing interventions show the model uses input differences that depend on both the expert and the token.

</details>


### [106] [When to Assist and What to Suggest: Joint Gating and Memory-Grounded Hint Generation in One Compact Decoder](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.40611)
*A. J. A. Jubayer Talukder,Mohammad Ariful Haque*

Main category: cs.CL

TL;DR: 研究比较了主动式对话助手的提示决策与生成方案，发现记忆对提示质量至关重要；单一模型可兼顾决策和生成，并以更低延迟达到有竞争力的效果。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 主动式助手需要在对话中判断何时提供帮助，以及提供什么简短提示。现有系统通常将这两项任务交给独立的决策门控器和较大的生成模型，但分阶段评估可能高估实际端到端表现，因此需要在真实组合流程中比较效果、效率及记忆的作用。

Method: 研究在28,058个决策点上联合评估门控与生成。比较分阶段生成所给出的理想门控上限、由独立门控器和生成器组成的两模型流程，以及由一个十亿参数解码器在同一轮推理中完成门控与生成的方案；另通过移除记忆、改变检索和模型规模分析提示质量，并对32段对话收集1,144条人工评分。

Result: 真实门控下，端到端精确匹配率为0.2619，低于理想门控上限0.2971；端到端精确率为0.2387。门控能提高精确率并节省计算，但相对计算节省随生成器从八十亿参数缩小到十亿参数而由4.39倍降至1.38倍。移除记忆使精确匹配表现下降24.7个百分点，重标定的语义评分也由0.57降至0.35；增加检索或扩大生成器规模并未提升精确匹配。单一模型在最终检查点的自动端到端指标达到或超过同等规模的两模型流程，耗时减少1.31至1.76倍；跨三个随机种子，其较深层退出方案与独立门控器表现持平。人工评价支持记忆的重要性，并认为单一模型与同规模两模型流程相当，但低于八十亿参数方案。分级指标和模型内置评审器比精确匹配更贴近人工评价。

Conclusion: 主动提示质量主要依赖对话记忆，而不只是更强的生成器或额外检索。将门控与生成整合进单一模型可降低延迟，并在自动指标上取得有竞争力的效果。不过，端到端表现仍低于理想门控上限，且人工评价显示其尚未达到更大模型的水平；精确匹配应视为严格的性能下界。

Abstract: Proactive assistants offer short, memory-grounded hints during a conversation, deciding when to assist and what to suggest. Current systems split this between a gate and a larger generator; we evaluate both together on 28,058 decision points. Stage-wise generation scores are oracle-gate ceilings: behind a real gate, end-to-end exact match is 0.2619 against a ceiling of 0.2971, and end-to-end precision is 0.2387, leaving substantial headroom. A gate pays off through precision and compute, whose saving falls from 4.39x with an 8B generator to 1.38x with a 1B one. The memory profile drives hint quality: removing it costs 24.7 exact-match points (rescaled BERTScore 0.57 to 0.35), while retrieval and a larger generator add nothing on exact match. One 1B decoder can do both, gating from an intermediate layer and generating in the same pass. At its final checkpoint it matches or exceeds the two-model pipelines on automatic end-to-end measures with 1.31-1.76x less wall-clock time than the matched 1B pipeline; across three seeds, its deeper exit ties the separate gate. A human evaluation (1,144 ratings over 32 dialogues) supports the memory effect and rates the single model level with the matched 1B pipeline and below the 8B one. Graded metrics and LlamaPIE's native judge track human ratings more closely than exact match, which we report as a strict lower bound.

</details>


### [107] [ShallowDefend: Harnessing Shallow Safety Alignment for Multi-Turn Defender](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.40627)
*Qiyao Ma,Xiaodong Liu,Weiwei Yang,Mingqian Feng,Chengquan Guo,Jialin Song,Carolyn Buractaon,Zhe Zhao,Junshan Zhang,Sandeep Atluri,Christopher White,Jianfeng Gao*

Main category: cs.CL

TL;DR: 论文提出“评估—决策—回应”防护框架：先判断多轮对话意图并明确提交安全决策，再据此生成回复，以强化多轮安全性。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有安全对齐容易拒绝直接的有害请求，却常被分散在多轮对话中的请求绕过。论文认为，其根源在于安全行为主要集中于回复开头的少数词元，而常见防护只训练回复表面形式，没有让模型显式学习安全决策。

Method: 框架先评估用户意图，再提交可解析的安全决策，最后根据该决策生成回复；通过强化学习在关键请求轮次训练这一决策。由于决策以明确文本片段呈现，可采用无需评审模型或人工标注的自验证奖励，将决策标签与对话已知属性核对；也可采用大语言模型评审奖励，在包含安全引导的分级决策空间中评分。

Result: 在两个模型系列、涵盖安全性、效用和帮助性的十四项基准测试中，该方法在受控比较中取得最强的多轮安全表现，并保持安全性领先，同时维持效用，代价是帮助性略有下降。逐词元的散度分析与干预探测还显示，训练影响集中于决定回复走向的短暂决策阶段，且该决策构成具有因果作用的控制点。

Conclusion: 论文将模型安全行为集中于回复开头这一弱点转化为防护机会：在生成回复前显式作出并训练安全决策，可有效提高多轮对话中的安全性。

Abstract: Safety alignment has enabled large language models to reliably refuse harmful requests directly, yet the same request distributed across a multi-turn conversation still succeeds far too often. This brittleness has a mechanistic root: Alignment is shallow, with safety behavior concentrated in a model's first few output tokens, and existing defenses inherit the weakness, supervising the surface form of the response without ever giving the model an explicit safety decision to learn. We take the opposite view of shallowness: if a short span determines the trajectory of an entire response, that span is the highest-leverage place to intervene, and the defender can occupy it first. We propose Assess $\to$ Decide $\to$ Respond, a framework in which the defender assesses the user's intent, commits to an explicit, parseable safety decision, and only then generates a reply conditioned on it, with the commitment trained by reinforcement learning at the payload turn. Because the decision is a token span, the reward can be a rule: a self-verified reward checks the committed label against the conversation's known nature, requiring no judge and no annotation, while the same format also supports an LLM-as-judge reward over a graded decision space with safe redirection. Across two model families and fourteen benchmarks spanning safety, utility, and helpfulness, our defenders achieve the strongest multi-turn safety in a controlled comparison, maintaining their lead in safety while preserving utility at a modest cost to helpfulness. A per-token KL analysis and interventional probes confirm why this works: training concentrates its effect on the brief deliberation that sets a response's trajectory, and the decision committed there is a causal control point. The very shallowness attackers exploit becomes the mechanism of defense.

</details>


### [108] [Elucidating the Design Space of LM Data Attribution](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.40655)
*Steven Yu,Sheng-Yu Wang,Kimia Hamidieh,Antonio Torralba,David Bau*

Main category: cs.CL

TL;DR: 论文提出可控的合成事实溯源基准，发现文档冗余和词汇干扰会降低归因效果；通过改用负对数几率梯度并聚合得分最高的词元，可显著提升事实来源识别能力。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有语言模型数据归因评测往往同时改变多个数据集属性，因此难以判断算法为何失败。论文旨在建立可控评测环境，逐项诊断影响归因表现的因素，并考察梯度损失形式与词元分数聚合方式这两项较少研究的设计选择。

Method: 作者构建可控归因基准：使用完全虚构的知识微调语言模型，从而获得明确的事实来源真值；再分别调整文档冗余、词汇干扰等数据配置。方法上，作者以负对数几率梯度替代常见交叉熵梯度，并利用词元级归因分数的局部性，只聚合得分最高的词元，而不对整篇文档的分数取平均。

Result: 实验表明，文档冗余和词汇干扰会持续损害归因表现。训练文档中的因果证据高度集中于少数词元，整篇文档平均会稀释这些信号。采用负对数几率梯度并聚合高分词元后，多种基线方法在诊断基准上的真值召回率提高了三十五至七十二个百分点。负对数几率校正也能迁移至另一事实溯源评测，在所有受测方法上提升反事实重训练表现，最高达到原来的四点九倍。

Conclusion: 论文的核心贡献不是提出新的归因估计器，而是提供可逐项控制的数据归因评测，并揭示了两项有效改进：用负对数几率梯度突出关键证据，避免对整篇文档平均而稀释局部信号。结果说明，合理选择梯度目标和分数聚合方式，能够显著改善数据归因及其在反事实评测中的表现。

Abstract: Data attribution methods for Language Models (LMs) are typically evaluated using downstream tasks like fact retrieval. However, existing evaluations vary multiple dataset properties simultaneously, making it impossible to isolate exactly why an attribution algorithm fails. To diagnose these failures, we explore the design space of LLM data attribution, with a primary focus on evaluation. We introduce the Controlled Attribution Benchmark (CATT) for fact tracing, in which we fine-tune LLMs on entirely fictitious knowledge, providing unambiguous ground truth for attribution. This synthetic setup allows us to systematically alter one dataset configuration at a time, such as document redundancy and lexical distractors. With this configurable evaluation, we demonstrate that redundancy and distractors consistently degrade attribution performance. Rather than proposing a new estimator, we examine two design choices that are underexplored: the loss used to compute gradients and how per-token attribution scores are aggregated into a document score. We find that the true causal evidence within a training document is highly localized, but standard methods dilute this evidence into noise by averaging attribution scores across the entire document. We find that replacing standard cross-entropy loss gradients with the negative log-odds gradients surfaces the critical tokens from other uninformative ones. We can then aggregate only the top token scores to improve ground truth recall by 35 to 72 percentage points across multiple baselines on our diagnostic benchmark. The negative log-odds correction also generalizes to FTRACE-TREX, improving counterfactual retraining performance for every method we test, by up to 4.9x.

</details>


<div id='cs.AI'></div>

# cs.AI [[Back]](#toc)

### [109] [LRMoE: Demand-Side Load Re-Calibration for Efficient MoE Training on Memory-Constrained Nodes](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.37720)
*Jiaming Hu,Zhida Jiang,Zhaolong Xing,Yu Li,Zhen Chen,Ke Zhang*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: 本文提出一种面向显存约束的稀疏混合专家模型训练系统，通过筛选并重新分配反向传播中的令牌—专家计算，降低通信、计算和缓冲区开销；在两种大规模模型上，相较基线方法，达到固定损失目标所需的专家层累计训练时间缩短百分之二十一点二至百分之四十四点八。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 稀疏混合专家模型虽能扩展模型容量，但专家路由不均会造成计算与通信瓶颈。现有的专家放置和复制方法可以重新分配负载，却会使额外专家副本与令牌相关缓冲区争夺有限的显存。因此，需要在显存约束下同时平衡负载，并降低反向传播开销。

Method: 系统在前向执行期间，根据资源约束规划各专家的保留额度与放置位置，同时保留全部路由计算。反向传播时，利用负载重校准指标估算每个令牌—专家组合对专家更新的贡献，并按额度筛选组合；随后通过容量感知路由，将保留组合分配给其原属专家的合格实例。最后进行物理压缩，形成更小的通信载荷，并采用可变规模的分组矩阵乘法，以减少反向传播的通信量、计算量和执行缓冲区需求。

Result: 在两种大规模稀疏混合专家模型上的实验表明，与对比基线相比，该系统达到固定损失目标时，专家层累计训练时间减少百分之二十一点二至百分之四十四点八。

Conclusion: 该研究表明，在不改变前向路由计算的前提下，依据专家更新贡献筛选反向传播工作，并结合容量约束下的重新分配与物理压缩，可以缓解显存竞争和负载不均问题，从而提升稀疏混合专家模型的训练效率。

Abstract: Sparse Mixture-of-Experts (MoE) models offer scalable capacity for Web applications, but uneven routing creates computation and communication bottlenecks. Existing placement and replication methods redistribute this workload, yet additional expert copies compete with token-related buffers for limited GPU memory. We present LRMoE, a memory-aware MoE training system that jointly recalibrates backward demand and balances the retained workload. During forward execution, it plans retention quotas and expert placement under resource constraints while preserving all routed computations. During backpropagation, a load recalibration metric estimates each token-expert pair's contribution to the expert update and selects pairs within these quotas. A capacity-aware routing algorithm distributes retained pairs among eligible instances of their original experts. Physical compaction then forms smaller communication payloads and variable-size grouped GEMMs, reducing backward traffic, computation, and execution-buffer demand. Experiments on Qwen3-30B-A3B and GLM4.5-106B-A12B show that LRMoE reduces cumulative MoE-layer training time to fixed-loss targets by 21.2-44.8% relative to SYMI.

</details>


### [110] [Amortized Localized Posterior Inference for Model Calibration with Application to an Ocean Turbulence Closure](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.37731)
*Exaucé Luweh Adjim Ngarti,Élise Arnaud,Léo Nicoletti,Victor Trappler,Arthur Vidard*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: 研究提出按上下文局部加权的参数校准方法，以处理模型偏差及观测、上下文不确定性；在两个案例中，相比全局校准，局部校准降低了汇总预测误差。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 当模型存在偏差时，单一校准参数可能无法在不同上下文下同时重现物理响应。观测值和上下文本身的不确定性也会影响校准结果，因此需要在推断中纳入并量化这些不确定性。

Method: 针对每个目标上下文构造局部后验：依据观测上下文与目标上下文的接近程度，对观测似然加权；采用高斯局部权重，并通过协方差膨胀纳入上下文不确定性，同时处理上下文域边界，且可校正上下文采样不均。随后以条件归一化流和摊销变分推断近似整族局部后验，并按照指定的上下文测度对其积分，得到边缘化参数分布。

Result: 在布拉宁—胡基准模型的双胞胎实验中，无论上下文分布均匀还是偏斜，局部推断的汇总预测误差均低于全局后验推断。在单柱海洋模型的应用中，以大气表面强迫为上下文，局部后验校准相较确定性校准和全局后验校准，降低了温度与纬向流速误差。

Conclusion: 局部后验校准能够利用上下文差异，缓解单一全局参数难以适应模型偏差的问题，并在所研究案例中改善预测表现。不过，两个实验均特意设置为允许局部补偿，因此结果主要支持该方法在这类情形下的有效性，不应直接视为对所有模型和场景的普遍保证。

Abstract: Model discrepancy may prevent a single calibration parameter from reproducing a physical response across the context domain. In addition, uncertainties in observations and contexts affect calibration and must be accounted for and quantified. We construct a family of localized posteriors by weighting observation likelihoods according to their proximity to a target context. Gaussian localization weights incorporate context uncertainty through covariance inflation, with reflection at domain boundaries and an optional correction for uneven context sampling. A conditional normalizing flow approximates the family of posteriors through amortized variational inference. Integrating the localized posteriors under a prescribed context measure gives the marginalized parameter distribution. In a twin experiment with the Branin-Hoo model, we compare global and localized inference under uniform and skewed context distributions. Localization reduces the reported aggregate predictive errors relative to the global posterior. An application to the k-$ε$ turbulence closure in a single-column ocean model, with atmospheric surface forcing as context, shows that localized posterior calibration reduces temperature and zonal-velocity errors relative to deterministic and global-posterior calibration. Both twin experiments are constructed to admit local compensation.

</details>


### [111] [ThinkJev: One Thought, Every Budget for Calibrated Typed Decisions](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.37732)
*Xiaolu Ding,Kai Yang,Dongdong Liu*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: 本文提出一种按需分配推理计算的方法：简单决策直接读取模型输出，复杂决策再进行思考，并可在准确率与计算成本之间灵活权衡。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 许多语言模型应用需要从有限选项中作出决策。直接读取模型单次前向计算得到的选项概率速度快，但在算术、计数和日期比较等多步任务上容易出错；让模型先思考通常能提高准确率，却显著增加延迟和计算成本。因此，本文希望只在确有必要时启用思考。

Method: 该方法基于同一个具备混合思考能力的模型构建快、慢两套决策系统：快系统读取模型直接作答时各选项字母的概率，慢系统读取模型思考后的相同概率。两者使用同一缓存提示和同一组选项，因此升级到慢系统时无需重复处理提示；一次采样的思考还可在不同思考长度下读取答案。方法无需训练：先依据带标签的开发集进行统计检验，只有在错误率受目标上限约束时才允许快系统独立作答；其余决策则在思考过程中，一旦答案置信度足够便停止。

Result: 在错误率目标为百分之五时，二百七十亿参数模型在八千三百五十九项测试决策中，有百分之二十四点五可由快系统直接处理，实际错误率为百分之三点九；四十亿和九十亿参数模型对应比例分别为百分之六点五和百分之零。对剩余决策采用思考中途停止后，准确率为百分之八十一点六，略低于始终思考的百分之八十二点七，但思考令牌减少百分之七十二。仅凭快系统置信度决定是否思考，节省效果较弱，因为快系统最不确定的决策往往并非思考最能纠正的决策。在公开基准的探索性测试中，该方法触发思考的比例为百分之二十九点四，准确率与两种受测思考接口未见显著差异。

Conclusion: 研究表明，将受统计保证的直接作答与按需、可提前停止的思考结合起来，可以在维持接近完整思考准确率的同时减少推理开销。结果也提示，是否启用思考不能只依据模型自身的置信度，还需利用验证数据评估快系统在哪些决策上足够可靠。

Abstract: Many uses of language models end in a typed decision: a choice among a closed set of options, whose probabilities code can act on. Reading those probabilities from one forward pass is fast but often wrong on decisions that take several steps, such as arithmetic, counting, and date comparison. Letting the model think first fixes most of these errors, but costs seconds per decision instead of milliseconds. To pay for thinking only where it helps, ThinkJev builds a fast and a slow system from one open hybrid-thinking model that can answer directly or after a thought. System 1 reads the model's probabilities for the option letters when it answers directly; System 2 reads the same letters after the model has thought on the same cached prompt, so escalating repeats no work and both systems give probabilities over the same options. Because the letters can be read after any number of thought tokens, one sampled thought also gives the answer under every thinking budget. Without training, ThinkJev lets System 1 answer alone only where a statistical test on labeled dev data guarantees that its accepted answers stay under a target error rate. At a 5% target, Qwen3.5-27B answers 24.5% of 8359 test decisions this way with a realized error of 3.9% (Qwen3.5-4B and 9B: 6.5% and 0.0%). For the rest, stopping each thought as soon as its answer is confident reaches 81.6% accuracy, against 82.7% for always thinking, with 72% of the thought tokens. Choosing when to think from System 1's confidence alone saves less, because the decisions System 1 is least sure of are often not the ones thinking fixes. On the public items of JevBench, an independent benchmark of typed-decision services, Qwen3.5-27B thinks on 29.4% and is not distinguishable in accuracy from the two thinking APIs listed (exploratory). Code and data generators are available at https://github.com/ding-xiaolu/ThinkJev.

</details>


### [112] [OpenFrontiers: A Collection of Open Research Problems and a Benchmark for Scientific Rediscovery](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.37739)
*Jiarui Yao,Ruida Wang,Tong Zhang*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: 论文提出“开放前沿”资源，将大规模开放研究问题语料与数学问题回溯基准结合，用形式化验证评估大语言模型能否独立重新发现已知结果。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 大语言模型在研究级问题求解方面展现出潜力，但目前缺少覆盖广泛、信息结构清晰的研究问题资源；同时，评测难以区分模型真正独立推导出结果，还是仅从网络检索到现成答案。论文旨在建立兼具问题资源与严格评测能力的基础设施。

Method: 研究构建了包含一万二千一百五十一个问题的跨学科语料，记录问题陈述、背景和研究进展；另建立包含二百道数学问题的回溯基准，其中一百一十道已于二〇二六年解决，九十道仍未解决。每题均提供经自动探测和两名独立评审检查的莱恩四形式化陈述，并筛选出高质量子集。评测中，模型生成的证明由两个独立检查器在隔离环境中验证，并分别在闭卷、固定检索和实时网络条件下测试；七个模型智能体在统一预算下评测高质量五十题子集。

Result: 在四十道已有解答的问题中，闭卷条件下模型独立重新发现解答的数量最多为七道，表明此类能力仍较罕见。实时网络条件下的成功大多来自检索已发表解答，而非独立推导。形式化证明检查和分条件评测有助于更清楚地区分这些能力来源。

Conclusion: 该资源把广泛的研究问题语料与具有文档化解答、可形式化评分的数学基准连接起来，为衡量大语言模型的研究级独立发现能力提供了基础，也为研究模型解决当前开放科学问题的进展提供了评测框架。

Abstract: Large language models (LLMs) have shown increasing promise in research-level problem solving, yet a comprehensive collection of such problems is still missing, and evaluating them on research-level problems remains challenging. We introduce OpenFrontiers, a cross-disciplinary resource that combines a structured corpus of open research problems with a retrospective benchmark of recently resolved problems in mathematics. The corpus records problem statements, context, progress, and other information for 12,151 problems. The benchmark contains 200 problems, 110 resolved in 2026 and 90 still open, each with a Lean~4 statement checked by automated probes and two independent reviews; a subset HQ-50 further filters based on quality score, etc. Our evaluation protocol grades formal proofs with two independent checkers in an isolated sandbox under closed-book, frozen-retrieval, and live-web conditions. Evaluating seven LLM agents on the HQ-50 subset under a standardized budget, we find that closed-book rediscovery is rare, at most 7 of 40 resolved problems, whereas live-web success mostly reflects retrieval of published solutions. By linking a broad research-problem corpus to a formally graded evaluation subset with documented solutions, OpenFrontiers provides a foundation for measuring research-level rediscovery and studying progress toward solving currently open scientific problems. The dataset and benchmark could be found in https://huggingface.co/collections/FlippyDora/openfrontiers.

</details>


### [113] [WebAnything: From the Wild Web to Scalable Agent Environments](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.37786)
*Tianci Xie,Zikun Cai,Chaoyun Zhang,Pinxue Guo,Bingxuan Li,Rui Zheng,Hang Yan*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: 论文提出全自动网页环境重建框架，可从真实网址构建可复用、可重置且有来源依据的训练与评测环境，并展示其保真度及对网页智能体训练效果的提升。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 网页智能体训练和评测需要多样、可执行、可重置且结果可复现的网站环境。现有方法各有局限：人工辅助镜像需要逐站点开发；生成式构建可能偏离指定的真实网站；捕获并回放虽能保留观察内容，但交互范围受已捕获内容和回放能力限制。因此，论文旨在降低逐站点人工工程成本，同时更忠实地重建真实网页。

Method: 提出全自动框架“网页万物”，从真实网址重建有源网页环境。探索器—构建器收集浏览器可观察到的网页结构、资源和交互结果；独立验证器检查冻结后的候选环境，并据此指导局部修复或针对性地重新采集源网站内容。除初始设置和授权外，框架无需逐站点人工实现，也不需要后续人工修复。

Result: 研究构建了覆盖14个应用领域、53个类别的244个网站环境，并支持执行且通过验收的12,984项任务。在与人工辅助镜像系统网页港的盲审比较中，该方法在三项保真度指标上的综合表现更高：12项胜出、2项持平、无一项落败。使用5,856条交互轨迹微调九十亿参数模型后，在真实环境成功率上提高9.9个百分点；在奥德赛简易版的评分平均值和任务平均值上分别提高6.25和6.32个百分点；在网页竞技场验证版的总体成功率上提高13.33个百分点。上述训练评测结果是在固定测试流程下获得的。

Conclusion: 结果表明，自动化的采集、构建与独立验证流程能够规模化地产生较高保真、可复用的网页环境，并可为网页智能体训练带来实际收益。论文的贡献主要在于降低环境构建的逐站点人工依赖，同时以盲审和下游任务表现验证环境质量；其结果仍应结合所覆盖的网站类别和固定评测流程理解。

Abstract: Web agents require diverse, executable, and resettable website environments for reproducible training and evaluation. Human-assisted mirrors demand per-site engineering, while generative construction can diverge from specified real websites. Capture-and-replay preserves observations, with interaction coverage constrained by captured content and replay capabilities.
  We present WebAnything, a fully automated framework that reconstructs source-grounded, reusable Web environments from real URLs without per-site manual implementation or repair after initial setup and authorization. An Explorer-Builder collects browser-observable structures, resources, and interaction outcomes; an independent verifier checks frozen candidates and guides local repair or targeted source recapture.
  We construct 244 website artifacts across 14 application domains and 53 categories, supporting 12,984 executed and accepted tasks. Compared with human-assisted WebHarbor, WebAnything achieves higher aggregate scores on three fidelity metrics, with 12 wins, two ties, and no losses in a blind audit. Fine-tuning Qwen3.5-9B on 5,856 interaction trajectories improves REAL success by 9.9 percentage points, Odysseys-Easy Rubric Avg and Task Avg by 6.25 and 6.32 percentage points, and WebArena-Verified Overall success by 13.33 percentage points under the fixed harness. Code: https://github.com/china-qijizhifeng/Web-Anything

</details>


### [114] [What Does an Ontology Catch? Curated, LLM-Generated and Data-Derived Ontologies as Checkers of LLM Agents over Knowledge Graphs](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.37809)
*Michal Orzechowski,Rund Tawfiq,Tomasz Kosciolek*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: 本文评估不同来源的本体能否可靠地检查大语言模型代理在知识图谱问答中的答案，并发现精心编制的本体可能误报正确答案，其对真实错误的识别优势也十分有限。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 知识图谱问答代理常借助本体中的形式化规则检查答案，但检查器既可能漏掉错误，也可能把正确答案判错，导致代理进行不必要的修正。精心编制的本体是否值得其构建成本，以及它是否优于模型生成或从数据中提取的本体，尚不清楚。

Method: 研究将本体检查器本身作为评估对象，对比精心编制、由大语言模型生成和从数据中提取的三类本体。研究考察本体作为提示背景、答案检查器或兼具两种用途时的效果，覆盖开源权重与专有代理，以及公开知识图谱和一个近十亿条三元组的私有图谱；同时统计检查发现的错误和对正确答案的误报，并分析组合不同来源及向代理提供检查器具体反馈的效果。

Result: 不同来源的本体在发现错误与产生误报之间各有取舍。精心编制的本体按原样使用时，可能与其所对应的数据相矛盾。在UniProt上，它误标的正确答案多于从数据中提取的本体，也多于根据数据摘要（并遮蔽标识符）生成的本体。对于代理实际生成的答案，其标记结果的准确性仅略高于随机标记；此外，结构性检查会漏掉某些类型的错误。

Conclusion: 形式化本体并不能天然成为可靠的答案裁判。评估本体检查器时，必须同时衡量其纠错能力与误报代价，并核验本体是否忠实于实际数据。仅依赖精心编制的模式，或组合本体与检查反馈，并不能据此假定代理答案会更可靠。

Abstract: LLM agents that answer questions over Web knowledge graphs are increasingly wrapped in checks derived from the graph's ontology, on the assumption that a formal schema makes a reliable judge. Yet a checker can be wrong as well: it can miss errors, and it can flag correct answers and push the agent into "fixing" them. Whether a curated ontology is worth its cost as such a judge, and how it compares with an ontology an LLM writes or a schema mined from the data, is unknown. We make the checker itself the object of study. Across curated, LLM-generated and data-derived ontologies, used as prompt context, as a checker, or both, and across open-weight and proprietary agents on public graphs and a private graph of nearly $10^{9}$ triples, we account for what ontology-derived checks catch and what they wrongly flag. We show how each source trades caught errors against false alarms, how a curated schema used as published can contradict its own data, which errors structural checks miss, and whether combining sources or giving the agent the checker's specific feedback pays off. On UniProt, the curated ontology flags more correct answers than either an ontology derived from the data or one an LLM derives from a summary of the data with masked identifiers. On real agent answers, its flags are only marginally more precise than random flags.

</details>


### [115] [Measuring Where Intent Gets Lost in Agentic Smart Contract Synthesis](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.37830)
*Abhinav Goel,Agostino Capponi,Alfio Gliozzo,Chaitya Shah*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: 论文研究如何判断人工智能生成的智能合约是否真正符合用户要求，并提出先澄清需求、再用独立可执行模型核验的方案。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 能够运行的代码不一定实现了用户想要的行为。智能合约一旦部署便难以修改，行为偏差可能造成严重后果。论文因此关注需求在生成过程中如何丢失，以及现有评估方法能否可靠地发现偏差。

Method: 研究通过在生成合约与其应复现的原合约上重放相同交易，并比较执行结果来评估行为一致性；用预先植入的错误、独立编写的可执行答案模型和评分器审计来检验评估工具。基于此，论文提出“先引导需求”的架构：生成代码前向客户提出简短问题清单，再用独立模型核验合约，并将不一致之处交由客户确认，而非擅自改写代码。

Result: 常见评估方式（包括人工智能评审和标准分析工具）会漏掉明显错误，评分设计也会显著影响结论；只检查各系统共有的函数，会掩盖约一半的流程差异。与事后审查或修补相比，生成前提问在三种人工智能模型上效果更好；自动安全修复还可能破坏用户要求的行为。少量有针对性的问题即可补足简短描述中遗漏的许多需求，其价值也能在没有原始合约时估计。研究发布了工具、六百项任务及全部结果。

Conclusion: 智能合约生成的可靠性不仅取决于代码能否运行，更取决于需求是否被充分澄清、行为是否经过独立核验。将需求询问置于生成之前，并以可执行模型检查结果，是减少行为偏差的有效路径；这一经验也适用于其他将自然语言请求转化为程序的场景。

Abstract: AI agents can now write software from a plain-English description, but code that runs is not the same as code that does what was asked. This gap matters most for smart contracts, the programs behind Web3 applications that move money on a blockchain and cannot be fixed once deployed. We ask how to check whether an AI-written contract behaves as it should, and where the requested behavior gets lost.
  We design an evaluation built on execution rather than opinion. We replay the same transactions on an AI-written contract and on the original it should reproduce and measure how often they agree. We test every grading tool on planted mistakes, compare against an answer key written without the description, and audit our own scorer until known wrong answers cannot pass. Common methods, such as AI judges and standard analysis tools, miss obvious mistakes, and scoring choices matter too. Checking only the functions every system includes hid about half the difference between pipelines.
  We then propose an elicitation-first architecture. Before writing code, the agent asks the client a short checklist of questions, checks the contract against an independently written executable answer key, and returns disagreements to the client instead of silently rewriting code. Asking first matters far more than reviewing or patching afterwards, across three AI models, while automated security fixes often break requested behavior. A few well-chosen questions recover much of what a short description omits, and their value can be estimated without the original contract. To our knowledge, this is the first study in smart contract synthesis to gather missing requirements before generation and check the result against an independently written executable model. The lessons extend to any setting where AI agents turn requests into programs. We release our tools, 600 tasks and all results.

</details>


### [116] [Detecting Covert Collusion between AI Agents through Partner-Outsider Positive Listening](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.37849)
*Kevin Yandoka Denamganaï*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: 论文提出一种基于行为反应差异的事后检测方法，用于识别智能体是否通过隐蔽措辞代码进行沟通；该方法能检测私密沟通渠道，但不能单独证明存在合谋。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 智能体可能利用看似无害的消息，通过共享的秘密约定协调行动。只检查消息内容的监控器可能无法识别这类沟通，因此需要一种不依赖直接解读消息的行为检测方法。

Method: 研究提出“合作者—局外者积极倾听差值”：比较使用代码的合作伙伴与替换到同一位置、但未参与约定的局外智能体，在消息改写而含义保持不变时，其行动变化程度的差异。该指标通过事后重放已记录的提示计算。研究在模拟市场中设置五种条件，涵盖无合谋、联合奖励与中性消息、公开表达意图、隐蔽首字母代码，以及代码与公开意图并存。

Result: 存在代码时，该指标介于零点四八至零点五九之间，所有百分之九十五置信区间的下界均高于零点二九；不存在代码时，指标介于负零点一零至负零点零一。相比之下，仅分析消息的监控器未能可靠区分条件：一个只读取发言者消息的监控器在五十个市场中均判定为“否”，另一个读取所有卖家消息的监控器则在十个无合谋市场中误报九个。

Conclusion: 该行为测试能够揭示智能体是否利用依赖具体措辞的私密沟通渠道，且可通过事后重放实现。但它检测的是私密渠道的使用，而非合谋本身；若协调仅由激励机制驱动，或代码依赖消息含义而非具体措辞，该方法可能无法检测。

Abstract: AI agents that share a secret convention can coordinate through messages that look innocent, so a monitor that reads only the messages can miss them. We propose a behavioural test: a partner that uses a code reacts to the exact wording of a message, whereas an uninvolved agent placed in its seat does not. Partner--Outsider Positive Listening (PoPLi) is the difference between the two agents in how much their action changes when the message is reworded with its meaning kept, and it is computed after the fact by replaying logged prompts. In a simulated market with five conditions (no collusion, a joint reward with neutral messages, the same with an openly stated intention, a covert first-letter code, and the code with a stated intention), PoPLi is between 0.48 and 0.59 whenever the code is present (95% intervals all above 0.29) and between -0.10 and -0.01 without it. Message-only monitors did not separate the conditions: one reading the speaker's messages answered "no" in all 50 markets, and one reading every seller's messages flagged 9 of 10 markets with no collusion. PoPLi detects the use of a private channel, not collusion as such, and it cannot detect collusion through incentives alone or codes carried by meaning.

</details>


### [117] [Evaluating and improving AI agents for sequencing protocol understanding](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.37851)
*Chi-Lam Poon,Michael Goneos,Zezheng Song,Xi Chen*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: 本文提出一项以实验文档为依据的基准，用于评估智能体能否准确还原测序文库结构及其构建流程；结果显示，现有智能体常能给出大致正确的答案，却难以做到精确、可靠的还原。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有科学智能体基准很少检验智能体能否依据测序方案，准确重建具体的分子结构和生成流程。然而，这项能力对于分析定制化测序实验至关重要。

Method: 研究者构建了一个基于文档的评测基准，考察智能体对测序文库结构和分子工作流程的重建能力，并比较不同底层语言模型、智能体框架、额外知识以及程序规则和跨方案示例的积累方式对表现的影响。

Result: 前沿智能体通常能生成近似正确的重建结果，但在精确还原方面仍不可靠，问题尤其集中于分子状态表示和流程连接关系。更换底层语言模型带来的平均表现差异，大于更换智能体框架；但统计显著差异仅出现在分子状态重建上。小规模试验中，补充知识提升了寡核苷酸家族识别，却未提高分子工作流程的平均得分。自主积累规则和跨方案示例的验证表现并非单调改善，在所测试的过程中也未提升留出测试集上的分子工作流程平均得分。

Conclusion: 要让智能体可靠地分析复杂实验方案，不能仅满足于生成大致合理的答案。研究结果指出，需要采用更加受控且可验证的方法，提升智能体对分子状态及流程关系的精确推理能力。

Abstract: Existing scientific-agent benchmarks rarely evaluate whether agents can reconstruct the exact molecular structures and generation workflows specified by sequencing protocols, a capability critical for analyzing customized sequencing assays. We introduce LibStructBench, a document-grounded benchmark for reconstructing sequencing-library structures and molecular workflows. Our experiments show that frontier agents often produce approximately correct reconstructions but remain unreliable at exact reconstruction, particularly in molecular-state representation and workflow connectivity. Switching the underlying language model produced larger average performance differences than switching agent harnesses, with a statistically significant difference only for molecular-state reconstruction. Additional knowledge improved oligo-family recovery in a small pilot without improving mean molecular-workflow scores. Autonomous accumulation of procedural rules and cross-protocol examples showed non-monotonic validation performance and no mean held-out molecular-workflow improvement in the tested trajectory. These findings highlight the need for more controlled and verifiable approaches to scientific reasoning about molecular processes in complex experimental protocols.

</details>


### [118] [Seq@K: Evaluating Language Models Under Sequential Feedback](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.37859)
*Thomson Yen,Gilbert Yang,Naimeng Ye,Minghui Chen,Dong Xia,Tianyi Shen,Yechan Jeon,Yaqin Chen,Daksh Mittal,Fangyu Wu,Hongseok Namkoong*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: 论文提出“序列K次尝试评测”，衡量模型在每次失败后获得反馈并继续尝试时解决问题的能力。实验表明，该评测能揭示与单次或多次独立作答评测不同的模型表现与选择结果。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 语言模型能够在上下文中理解自然语言反馈，并据此逐步修正答案，这是智能体工作流的重要能力。然而，常见评测主要统计一次作答或多次独立作答的成功率，无法反映模型如何利用先前失败的反馈。现有多轮智能体基准则通常聚焦长程规划，未能单独衡量反馈驱动的迭代修正能力。

Method: 提出序列K次尝试评测：模型最多进行K次连续尝试，每次失败后都会收到反馈，并以能否在限定尝试次数内解决问题作为评测依据。研究在七个基准和十六个前沿模型上开展评估，并分析模型的修正过程，包括其解决反馈所指出问题的速度、对原有答案的坚持程度，以及不同反馈形式带来的影响。

Result: 该评测呈现出与传统评测显著不同的模型选择图景：模型排名常有变化；帕累托前沿能够显示更高效的模型配置；相较于传统多次作答评测，选择最优配置所带来的收益可能增大，也可能减小。轨迹分析还揭示了模型利用反馈和修正答案的行为差异；反馈的性质会影响迭代修正效果。

Conclusion: 对于通常在反馈循环中运行的智能体系统，仅评估独立作答能力并不充分。序列K次尝试评测更直接地衡量模型从反馈中学习并逐步修正的能力，因此模型评估与系统设计都应重视反馈循环的具体形式及其基准测试。

Abstract: Language-model agents differ fundamentally from prior intelligent systems in their ability to learn from natural language in context. This capability enables agents to iteratively refine their answers in response to feedback, a prevalent mode of operation in modern agentic workflows. However, the community primarily ranks models by metrics such as Pass@1 or Pass@K, which cannot capture how they utilize feedback on prior attempts. We introduce Seq@K, a natural evaluation protocol that measures whether a model can solve a problem within K sequential attempts, provided feedback after each previous failure. Unlike multi-turn agentic benchmarks that examine long-horizon planning, Seq@K isolates and formalizes the core capability of refinement from feedback. We evaluate Seq@K on a suite of 7 benchmarks and 16 frontier models, and show that Seq@K reveals a materially different model-selection landscape: under Seq@K, (1) model rankings often differ, (2) the Pareto frontiers admit more efficient configurations and (3) the gains from choosing the optimal model configuration can widen or shrink relative to those of Pass@K. We further show that analyzing model trajectories under Seq@K helps characterize iterative refinement behavior, such as the rate at which models address issues raised in feedback, or how rigidly they hold onto their own answers. Finally, we study how the nature of feedback affects models' iterative refinement, showing that practitioners must carefully design and benchmark the feedback loops of iterative agentic systems. Together, these results establish how Seq@K offers a more faithful metric for intelligent systems that typically operate in such feedback loop, and the necessity to consider Seq@K in evaluating models for these systems.

</details>


### [119] [What Constitutes Food Similarity? Visual Representations and Retrieval in Indian Cuisine](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.37867)
*Saransh Kumar Gupta,Akshadha Sharma,Lipika Dey,Partha Pratim Das,Ramesh Jain*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: 研究发现，食物相似性并非固定属性，而会随视觉表征、信息模态和分析层级变化；仅凭识别准确率无法判断模型是否形成了有意义的食物关系结构。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 食物图像表征通常依据能否正确识别菜品来评估，却未必能说明模型如何组织不同食物、是否揭示烹饪关系，以及不同表征得出的相似性是否一致。印度菜尤其适合检验这一问题：外观相近的食物可能属于不同菜系类别，而同一烹饪家族中的食物也可能外观差异很大。

Method: 研究使用扩展后的印度菜肴数据集，比较七种预训练视觉表征，涵盖卷积模型、视觉变换器、自监督模型及图像—文本对齐模型。分析包括图像到图像检索、图像到菜品邻域、烹饪家族结构、对照案例和不同表征间的一致性；此外，将图像表征汇总到菜品层级，比较各模型的视觉相似性，并与同一批菜品基于食谱得到的相似性进行对照。

Result: 图像层级的邻域结构因视觉表征而显著不同，且相似关系可能跨越烹饪家族边界。汇总到菜品层级后，各模型呈现出一定的共同视觉结构，但这种结构与食谱所反映的相似性关联较弱。

Conclusion: 食物相似性取决于所用表征、信息模态和抽象层级，而不是数据集中食物固有且唯一的关系。要将图像、食谱等多种食物信息整合成连贯的相似性概念，必须先理解各模态及表征所形成的关系结构；单一的识别表现不足以完成这一评估。

Abstract: Food similarity underlies retrieval, recommendation, substitution, and other food computing tasks, yet food representations are typically evaluated by identity preservation. We ask what happens to food similarity beyond identity: how different visual representations organize foods into relational neighborhoods, what culinary relationships these neighborhoods reveal or obscure, and how consistently these structures emerge across representations. Indian cuisine provides a challenging setting in which visually similar foods may have different culinary identities, while foods within a culinary family can vary substantially in appearance. Using an expanded Khana dataset and seven pretrained visual representations spanning convolutional, transformer-based, self-supervised, and image-text aligned models, we evaluate image-to-image retrieval and image-to-dish neighborhoods, examining culinary-family structure, contrast cases, and cross-representation agreement. We also aggregate image representations to compare dish-level visual similarity across models and against recipe-derived similarity for the same dishes. Image-level neighborhoods vary substantially across representations, including similarities across culinary-family boundaries. At the dish level, aggregation reveals common visual structure despite local variation, but this structure corresponds less strongly with recipe-derived similarity. These findings show that recognition performance alone cannot characterize relational structure: food similarity depends on representation, modality, and abstraction level rather than being a fixed property of the food collection. Understanding these structures is therefore a prerequisite to combining multiple food information modalities into a coherent notion of similarity.

</details>


### [120] [Verification Learning Theory: A Process Model of Checking and Retention in AI-Assisted Judgment](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.37875)
*Christoph Trattner*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: 论文提出验证学习理论，解释可靠人工智能助手可能提升即时判断、却削弱独立判断练习；其核心机制是证据核查促进规则保留，但目前的模拟并非实证验证。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 准确的人工智能辅助可以改善当下判断，却可能减少人们亲自练习判断规则的机会，进而影响延迟后的独立表现。论文旨在形式化这一潜在权衡，并提出可检验的机制与实验预测。

Method: 建立验证学习理论模型，将人们感知到的助手可靠性与证据核查联系起来，并将核查历史与规则的保留及后续使用联系起来。严格版本假设任务要求和感知可靠性只通过核查影响学习，且每次真实核查带来相同程度的学习。论文通过模拟考察这些假设的后果及参数敏感性，并与深度加工和反馈编码解释进行比较。

Result: 模型预测，即使没有观察到助手犯错，认为助手可能出错也能通过促使核查，改善延迟后的无辅助判断；但如果核查本已被要求且确实完成，这种优势就会消失。模型还预测，收益应体现为针对练习规则的提升，并可依据核查历史作出判断表现预测。模拟展示了这些预测及其对参数的依赖，但不构成实证验证。论文指出，部分预测可区分不同理论，另一些情况下理论仍可能产生相同的可观察结果。

Conclusion: 验证学习理论为研究人工智能辅助与独立学习之间的权衡提供了明确框架，并提出了检验其机制的实验方案。该框架也区分了练习过的规则能否被保留，与面对新主张时能否识别应使用哪条规则这两个不同问题。

Abstract: Accurate AI assistance can improve immediate judgments while reducing opportunities to practise the operations needed for independent performance. Verification Learning Theory (VLT) formalises this possibility for claim-evaluation practice followed by correct, independent, rule-specific feedback. The model links perceived assistant reliability to evidence checking and links the history of those checks to retained rule use. Its strict form assumes that task demands and perceived reliability influence learning only through checking, with equal learning per genuine check. It therefore predicts that perceived fallibility can improve delayed unaided judgment even without observed assistant errors, and that this advantage disappears when checking is already required and performed. Rule-specific gains and forecasts from checking histories provide further tests. Simulations examine the consequences and parameter dependence of these commitments; they do not constitute empirical validation. Comparisons with depth-of-processing and feedback-encoding accounts identify where predictions diverge and where the accounts remain observationally equivalent. The framework specifies experiments that can test the proposed mechanism and separates retention of practised rules from the broader problem of recognising which rule applies to a new claim.

</details>


### [121] [The Anatomy of Socio-Demographics in Pluralistic Offensiveness Modeling: When and Where It Helps, and the Role of Reasoning](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.37896)
*Yifan Wang,Leixin Zhang,Jinyi Mu,Yu Wang,Mayank Jobanputra,Isabel Valera,Vera Demberg*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: 研究发现，人口统计信息对个体冒犯性判断的预测提升较小且不稳定，但在群体和总体层面更有价值；引导模型显式推理人口特征如何影响判断，能更有效地利用这些信息。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 冒犯性等主观判断因人而异，因此建模时纳入标注者的社会人口特征，可能有助于呈现这种差异。然而，既有研究对这类信息是否改善预测结论不一。本文旨在系统考察其在哪些预测层面有效，以及模型如何利用这些信息。

Method: 作者在三个多标注者数据集上评估经提示和训练的大型语言模型，并比较不同预测层面及信息使用方式。其一，考察人口统计信息对个体、群体和总体预测的作用；其二，将个体判断显式拆解为总体基线判断与人口特征导致的偏移，并通过干预检验各部分对最终预测的影响；其三，比较直接输入人口特征与显式推理文本如何与标注者特征互动。

Result: 人口统计信息带来的个体预测收益较小且不一致，但在群体和总体层面更明显，因为聚合会削弱个体特有的波动，使较小但系统性的人口特征信号更突出。显式拆解的结果表明，人口统计信息既能改善基线判断，也能支持有意义的特征相关偏移；干预进一步显示，更准确地估计这两个部分会改善最终预测。与直接条件化相比，显式推理能更准确地估计基线、偏移和最终结果，而直接条件化通常难以产生有信息量的偏移。

Conclusion: 人口统计信息的价值取决于评估层面和模型使用信息的方式。以个体预测为唯一标准，可能低估其在群体及总体建模中的作用；让模型显式推理人口特征如何改变判断，比单纯提供特征更能发挥其预测价值。

Abstract: Subjective judgments such as offensiveness often vary substantially across individuals, motivating pluralistic modeling approaches that incorporate annotators' socio-demographic information to capture this variation. However, prior findings on the benefits of socio-demographic information for pluralistic modeling are mixed, calling for a systematic analysis of both its effectiveness and the mechanisms through which it improves prediction. In this work, we study $\textbf{when}$ and $\textbf{where}$ socio-demographics benefit pluralistic offensiveness modeling, as well as $\textbf{the role of explicit reasoning}$ in leveraging this information. Across three multi-annotator datasets with prompted and trained LLMs, we first show that demographic gains are small and inconsistent for individual predictions but become clearer at the group and population levels, because aggregation attenuates the idiosyncratic variation that masks small but systematic demographic signals. Second, using a reasoning and prediction format that explicitly decomposes individual judgment into an overall baseline and a demographic-specific deviation, we show that the gains arise from both components: demographic information improves baseline estimation and enables meaningful demographic-specific shifts, and interventions show that better component estimates improve final predictions. Finally, comparing direct demographic conditioning with explicit reasoning about how the text interacts with annotator demographics, we find that reasoning yields more accurate baseline and shift estimates as well as final predictions, whereas conditioning alone rarely produces informative shifts. These results suggest that the mixed evidence in prior work may partly stem from individual-level evaluation, and that the value of socio-demographic information depends on both how it is evaluated and how models are guided to use it.

</details>


### [122] [FilingLoop: Evaluating and Evolving LLM Agents for Corporate Disclosure Review and Revision](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.37905)
*Wentao Zhang,Yilei Zhao,Guangyan Gan,Shuo Sun,Lin William Cong*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: 论文提出面向企业披露审查与修订的交互式基准和智能体框架，通过逐案迭代及跨案例程序学习，提升监管要求的满足率与评论解决率。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 企业披露审查不仅需要阅读单份文件，还要发现相关文件间未明示的缺陷、补充缺失的公司事实，并确认修订有证据支持。现有金融问答评测较少检验这些交互能力，因此难以判断语言模型智能体能否胜任真实审查流程。

Method: 研究依据美国证券交易委员会的历史往来函件，重建了来自96家公司的380项审查任务，并设置不同信息约束。独立评估器依据6099项适用要求评估最终文件与回复，同时检查无依据陈述和有害修订。智能体在单个案例内循环进行审查和修订，并将要求级评估反馈转化为针对不同角色的操作指导，用于后续案例；该过程不更新模型权重，也不重做已评分任务。

Result: 在评测任务流中，采用演进机制后，要求满足率从24.28%升至27.96%，完整评论解决率从16.90%升至20.75%；相较固定策略，总代价增加5.8%。

Conclusion: 该研究将缺陷发现、公司事实获取与有证据支持的修订纳入同一审查流程，并提供要求级反馈以改进后续任务中的操作程序。结果显示，跨案例程序学习能带来一定性能提升，但也伴随适度成本增加。

Abstract: Public disclosure repositories such as SEC EDGAR support informed investment through web access to corporate filings. Supporting their review with language model agents requires discovering unstated deficiencies across related documents, acquiring missing company facts, and verifying that requested revisions satisfy evidence-backed requirements. Existing financial question-answering evaluations provide limited evidence of these interactive capabilities. We introduce \textbf{FilingLoop}, an interactive benchmark and a self-evolving agent framework for corporate disclosure review and revision. Grounded in historical U.S.\ Securities and Exchange Commission correspondence, FilingLoop reconstructs 380 predominantly IPO review tasks from 96 companies under distinct information constraints. An evaluator separate from the acting agents scores final filings and responses against 6,099 eligible requirements and audits unsupported claims and harmful revisions. Our framework couples iterative review and revision within each case with procedural learning across cases, converting requirement-level evaluation feedback into role-specific guidance without updating model weights. Updates affect only subsequent cases, allowing procedural adaptation to be assessed without retrying scored tasks. On the evaluated stream, evolution increases requirement fulfillment from 24.28\% to 27.96\% and full comment resolution from 16.90\% to 20.75\%, with a 5.8\% increase in total cost over the fixed-policy variant. FilingLoop connects the concerns an agent discovers with the company facts it obtains and the revisions it commits, providing requirement-level feedback for procedures used in later review tasks.

</details>


### [123] [Beyond Low-Pass Dynamics: Frequency-Selective Spiking Reservoirs with Resonant Neurons](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.37906)
*Aurora Micheli,Claudio Gallicchio,Nergis Tomen*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: 本文提出采用谐振放电神经元的脉冲储备网络，在保持事件驱动能效的同时提升频率相关时序模式的识别能力，并在十项基准任务中取得脉冲储备方法中的领先准确率。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有脉冲储备网络大多采用漏积分放电神经元，其低通动力学难以区分不同时间频率编码的信息，限制了时序特征的表达能力。研究旨在增强储备网络对频率特征的选择性，同时保留脉冲计算的低能耗优势。

Method: 提出谐振放电储备网络，以具有内在振荡动力学的谐振放电神经元取代传统漏积分放电神经元，并构建由不同神经元组成的异质群体。神经元能够选择性响应不同输入频率，从而形成更具区分性的时序表示。该方法在时间序列、序列图像、音频脉冲序列和神经形态视觉等十类基准任务上进行评估。

Result: 该方法的分类准确率高于基于漏积分放电神经元的储备网络，并在十项基准任务中达到脉冲储备方法的领先水平。与等效的非脉冲振荡储备网络相比，其能耗最高可降低十九倍，且未牺牲脉冲计算的能效优势。

Conclusion: 在脉冲储备网络中引入频率选择性动力学，能够提升时序表示质量与分类性能，同时保留事件驱动计算的能效。这表明谐振放电神经元为构建兼具识别能力与低能耗的脉冲储备网络提供了有效途径。

Abstract: Spiking reservoir computing combines the training efficiency of fixed recurrent reservoirs with the energy efficiency of event-driven inference, where computation is triggered by sparse spikes rather than executed densely at every timestep. However, existing spiking reservoirs almost exclusively rely on Leaky Integrate-and-Fire (LIF) neurons, whose low-pass dynamics limit their ability to distinguish information encoded at different temporal frequencies. We introduce HRF-Res, a liquid state machine in which LIF neurons are replaced by a heterogeneous population of Harmonic Resonate-and-Fire (HRF) neurons. These neurons exhibit intrinsic oscillatory dynamics and selectively respond to input frequencies, enabling the reservoir to capture frequency-specific temporal patterns. The result is more discriminative representations and higher classification accuracy than LIF-based reservoirs, achieved without sacrificing the energy efficiency of spiking computation, with up to 19x lower energy consumption than an equivalent non-spiking oscillatory reservoir. Evaluated on ten benchmarks spanning time series, sequential images, audio spike trains, and neuromorphic vision, HRF-Res achieves state-of-the-art accuracy among spiking reservoir methods. These results demonstrate that introducing frequency-selective dynamics into spiking reservoirs improves representational quality and classification performance while preserving their inherent energy efficiency.

</details>


### [124] [SciGame: Let Agents Play the Scientific Discovery Games in the Real and Counterfactual World](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.37919)
*Yusheng Zhao,Bowei He,Xue Liu,Mingxiao Li*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: 本文提出科学游戏基准，用于检验大语言模型智能体能否在熟悉与陌生环境中识别或发现精确科学规律。实验显示，先验知识可能造成误导，自适应实验效果因模型能力而异，而恢复精确数学形式仍是主要难点。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有基准常将规律推断与编程能力混在一起，侧重拟合已知数据而非预测未见输入，也难以区分模型从实验中获得的证据与预训练形成的先验。研究因此需要一种可控评测，专门衡量智能体依据证据推断科学规律的能力。

Method: 作者构建科学游戏基准，将科学文献转化为结构化科学卡片。每张卡片对应一组原始环境与量纲一致的反事实环境，两者使用相同任务接口。基准包含经典规律的历史集合，以及收录模型知识截止时间之后发表论文的时序集合；评测涵盖候选引导的规律识别和开放式规律发现，并分别采用仅先验、固定实验与自适应实验三种协议。

Result: 对五种前沿模型的实验发现：改变支配关系后，熟悉的先验会损害表现；在实验预算有限时，自适应实验能提升较强模型的表现，却会降低较弱模型的表现；解释质量较高并不代表定量预测正确。即使模型能够正确解读证据，恢复精确符号形式仍是主要瓶颈。

Conclusion: 当前智能体已能主动调查系统并利用实验信息，但在陌生情境中归纳精确规律仍未解决。该基准通过控制环境、知识时效和实验协议，为区分先验依赖、证据推理与精确规律发现提供了评测工具。

Abstract: Large language model agents are increasingly used for scientific discovery. However, existing benchmarks mix law inference with programming, score data fitting instead of prediction on unseen inputs, and do not separate empirical evidence from pretrained priors. We introduce SciGame, a controlled benchmark that converts scientific literature into structured scientific cards. Each card yields a pair of Original and dimensionally consistent Counterfactual environments with the same task interface. SciGame contains a Historical collection of canonical laws and a live Temporal collection curated from papers published after model knowledge cutoffs. It evaluates agents in candidate-guided Identification and open-ended Discovery settings. Each setting runs under Prior-only, Fixed, and Adaptive protocols. Experiments on five frontier models yield three findings. First, familiar priors hurt performance once the governing relation is altered. Second, adaptive experimentation helps the strongest models but harms weaker ones under limited budgets. Third, good explanations can hide quantitative failures. Recovering the exact symbolic form remains the main bottleneck, even when agents interpret evidence correctly. Current agents can investigate systems actively, but inducing exact laws in unfamiliar settings remains an open challenge.

</details>


### [125] [VerifiedLab: Harnessing Knowns for Unknowns](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.37923)
*Yu Yao,Jiayi Dong,Yang Yang,Shuiwang Ji,Ju Li*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: 论文提出一种多智能体框架，将科研文献转化为经过逐项核验、可供人工智能科研代理使用的知识系统，并在钙钛矿太阳能电池领域验证其有效性。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 随着人工智能科研代理逐渐参与实验研究，知识正从面向人类阅读的记录转向面向机器使用的知识。传统文献虽保存了研究成果，却未必便于机器可靠地提取、验证和用于预测，因此需要新的知识组织与可信度评估机制。

Method: 研究提出“验证实验室”多智能体框架。不同角色的人工智能科学家协作处理科研记录：首席研究者负责规划，文献管理员直接从记录中计算证据，领域专家撰写结论，审核关卡与批评者则依据数据的实测可靠性逐项核查主张。框架据此决定发布或暂缓发布信息，并可通过增加推理阶段的核验计算来提高验证力度。

Result: 在钙钛矿太阳能电池领域的实验中，该框架能够重现已知物理趋势，预测一年后才报告的器件成果，并使人工智能科学家继承文献知识的同时获得相应的可信度信息。

Conclusion: 该研究展示了将科研成果从被动文献转化为可验证、可调用知识系统的路径，有望促进知识传播、科研成果采用及趋势预测，并为人工智能协同科学研究提供机器可用的知识基础。

Abstract: Across human history, knowledge has undergone several transitions, from orality to writing and then to digital archives. At each transition, humans established new conventions to preserve knowledge for the new era. Nowadays, as research agents are increasingly deployed for laboratory experiments, knowledge is crossing another boundary: from records written for humans to those for machines. In this work, we introduce VerifiedLab, a multi-agent harness framework for this human-to-machine transition of knowledge. VerifiedLab transforms research output from passive artifacts into active systems that accelerate downstream use, adoption and prediction of future trends. In VerifiedLab, a team of AI scientists with distinct roles reasons over records verified field by field: a principal investigator plans, a librarian computes the evidence directly from the records, specialists draft, and a gate and a critic check each claim against the measured reliability of its data before the harness decides whether to release or withhold it. We demonstrate the efficacy of VerifiedLab through extensive experiments on perovskite solar cells: VerifiedLab recovers known physical trends, anticipates devices reported a year later, and lets AI scientists inherit the literature together with a measure of how far it can be trusted. By scaling the inference-time verification compute, VerifiedLab introduces a new pathway for knowledge dissemination and machine harness for AI co-scientists.

</details>


### [126] [GARDEN: Generalist Autonomous Reward Design Through Evidence Navigation for Cooperative Multi-Agent Reinforcement Learning](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.37926)
*Dogan Urgun*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: 本文提出一种面向相关协作场景的自主奖励设计方法：利用语言模型结合环境代码、训练记录和智能体行为设计奖励，并将同一奖励程序原样迁移到未见场景；在两个基准任务上均显著优于默认奖励及对比方法。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 协作多智能体强化学习的行为高度受奖励函数影响，但仅用任务成败作为奖励通常不足以指导学习，因此研究者往往需要手工设计中间奖励，并在环境或团队变化后重新调整。现有语言模型虽能自动编写奖励代码，但奖励通常只在单一场景中设计和测试，难以复用。

Method: 提出“基于证据导航的通用自主奖励设计”框架。语言模型充当奖励设计者，分析环境代码、训练记录与智能体行为，并通过试验训练评估候选奖励。框架针对一组相关场景开发一个奖励程序，再将其不作修改地用于设计阶段未提供的场景；同时固定学习算法和最终奖励的选择规则，以便进行公平比较。

Result: 在未见过的场景中，烹饪基准两个厨房布局的任务回报相较默认奖励提高58.2%；多智能体战斗基准两个场景的平均胜率从51.0%升至89.9%。在候选奖励数量和探测预算相同的条件下，该方法也优于固定诊断反馈和受“尤里卡”启发的奖励反思方法，后两者的对应表现为84.2%和79.2%。

Conclusion: 研究表明，语言模型可以通过多源证据与试验训练，自主设计可跨相关协作场景复用的奖励函数。该方法降低了逐场景手工设计奖励的需求，并在所评估的未见场景中提升了任务表现；其证据目前主要来自两个基准及有限场景。

Abstract: Cooperative multi-agent reinforcement learning (MARL) enables teams of agents, such as robots and autonomous vehicles, to learn coordinated behavior, but what such teams learn is largely determined by their reward function. Because task success alone provides too little guidance for learning, intermediate rewards are usually designed by hand, and this effort must often be repeated whenever the environment or the team changes. Large language models (LLMs) can automate the effort by writing reward functions as code, yet the resulting rewards are typically designed and tested in a single setting. To enable their reuse across settings, GARDEN (Generalist Autonomous Reward Design through Evidence Navigation) is proposed, in which one reward program is developed for a family of related scenarios and transferred, unchanged, to scenarios that were not available during its design. During development, environment code, training records, and agent behavior are investigated by an LLM reward engineer, and draft rewards are tested in trial training runs, while the learning algorithm and the rule for selecting the final reward are held fixed. On unseen scenarios of the Overcooked and SMAX benchmarks, task returns were increased by 58.2% and 52.5% over the default rewards on two kitchen layouts, and the mean win rate in two combat scenarios was raised from 51.0% to 89.9%. Under matched candidate and probe budgets, this exceeded the 84.2% and 79.2% obtained with fixed diagnostic feedback and Eureka-inspired reward reflection. These results show that a single autonomously engineered reward can be reused effectively across related cooperative scenarios.

</details>


### [127] [Understanding Large Language Models as Numerical Optimizers](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.37932)
*Lingyun Guo,Ali Bereyhi*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: 本文评估大型语言模型解决数值优化问题的能力，发现其能够利用问题结构生成接近最优的解，但可靠性会随维度增加而下降；迭代反馈可改善表现，数值验证仍不可或缺。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 大型语言模型在数值优化中展现出潜力，但其是否能理解并利用优化问题的结构、在高维情形下生成可行且接近最优的解，以及常见失败来自解的质量还是执行错误，尚缺乏清晰认识。

Method: 研究构建了区分解质量与执行失败的评估框架，将数值误差、约束违反和输出格式错误分别考察。实验选取凸优化、分式规划和约束投影问题，在不同维度下将模型结果与确定性参考求解器比较；另通过针对可行性和解质量的反馈进行迭代修正。

Result: 模型能够捕捉有用的优化结构并生成接近最优的解，但即使解的质量较好，也可能因数值或格式问题而无法有效执行。可靠性随问题维度增大而下降，并显著依赖问题结构。迭代修正能提高可靠性，并扩大模型能够有效求解的问题维度范围，但数值和结构性错误仍然存在。

Conclusion: 大型语言模型具备一定的优化推理能力，但现阶段尚不适合作为独立优化器。更可行的方向是将其结构理解与推理能力同确定性数值求解、可行性检查和结果验证结合，构建混合优化方法。

Abstract: Large language models (LLMs) have emerged as potential tools for numerical optimization. Despite promising results, their intrinsic optimization capabilities and limitations remain poorly understood, particularly in high dimensions. This paper investigates the ability of LLMs to exploit mathematical problem structures and generate feasible, near-optimal solutions. We develop an evaluation framework that distinguishes solution quality from execution failures, including numerical inaccuracies, constraint violations, and output-format errors. Using representative problems from convex optimization, fractional programming, and constrained projection, we assess LLM performance against deterministic reference solvers across different dimensions. Our results reveal that LLMs can capture useful optimization structures and produce near-optimal solutions, even when their outputs fail to satisfy numerical or formatting requirements. However, reliability deteriorates with increasing problem dimension and depends strongly on the underlying optimization structure. To further investigate the limitations, we deploy an iterative refinement mechanism that provides targeted feedback on feasibility and solution quality. The results demonstrate that iterative refinement substantially improves reliability and extends the range of problem dimensions over which LLMs produce valid solutions. Nevertheless, persistent numerical and structural errors limit their applicability as standalone optimizers. These findings provide insights into the capacity and limits of LLM-based optimization and motivate hybrid approaches that combine LLM reasoning with deterministic numerical verification.

</details>


### [128] [SkillMem: Compact External Skill Memory for Latent Multi-Agent Reasoning](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.37935)
*Yuxuan Zhu,Mohammad Mohammadi Amiri,Pin-Yu Chen,Keerthiram Murugesan*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: 论文提出技能记忆：以小型外部潜在记忆表示可复用技能，并通过角色条件读取器将其融入潜在多智能体推理，从而兼顾效果、推理效率与存储效率。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 潜在多智能体系统能以连续表示保存中间推理和智能体间通信，降低推理成本；但现有可复用技能通常以文本、逐层键值状态或专属模型参数存储，容易造成重复处理或较大的技能存储开销。论文旨在让技能能高效复用，同时不破坏潜在推理的效率。

Method: 将每项技能编码为小型外部潜在记忆，并使用角色条件交叉注意力读取器，根据智能体角色及其当前隐藏状态调用记忆。通过行为蒸馏联合训练技能记忆和共享读取器，使其复现文本技能对词元预测造成的变化，同时冻结基础模型。实验中的文本技能由成功与失败的多智能体轨迹配对获得；已有技能也可直接编译为记忆。

Result: 在六项基准测试及参数规模为40亿至140亿的通义千问第三代模型上，该方法对较小模型带来明显提升，并在不同模型规模下保持高效的潜在多智能体推理。所有模型使用相同的每项技能记忆配置，单项技能存储仅需9.6千字节（含检索嵌入）；存储100项技能时，相较其他表示方式，存储总量减少超过38倍，端到端推理速度最高提升4.23倍。

Conclusion: 紧凑的程序性潜在记忆能够以较低存储成本跨智能体、跨角色复用技能，并提升较小模型的表现；实验结果表明，这种复用方式无需牺牲潜在多智能体推理的效率。

Abstract: Latent multi-agent systems reduce inference cost by keeping intermediate reasoning and inter-agent communication in continuous representations.\ Reusable skills, however, are commonly supplied as text or stored as layer-wise Key-Value states or skill-specific model parameters, introducing repeated processing or substantial per-skill storage.\ We introduce \textbf{SkillMem}, which represents each reusable skill as a small external latent memory and makes it directly available during latent multi-agent reasoning.\ A role-conditioned cross-attention reader allows the same memory to guide different agents according to their roles and current hidden states.\ We train the skill memories and shared reader through behavioral distillation, matching the change in token predictions induced by a textual skill while keeping the backbone frozen.\ For our experiments, we obtain textual skills from paired successful and failed multi-agent trajectories, although existing skills can also be compiled directly.\ Across six benchmarks and Qwen3 models ranging from 4B to 14B parameters, SkillMem provides strong gains for smaller backbones while preserving efficient latent multi-agent inference across model scales.\ We use the same $8\times256$ memory configuration across all evaluated model scales, requiring 9.6\,KB of skill-specific storage per skill, including its retrieval embedding.\ For a library of 100 skills, SkillMem reduces total storage by more than $38\times$ compared with alternative skill representations and achieves up to a $4.23\times$ end-to-end inference speedup.\ These results show that compact procedural memories can be reused without sacrificing the efficiency of latent multi-agent reasoning.

</details>


### [129] [GAUSS: A Workload-Aware Analytical and Monte-Carlo Simulator for LLM Inference Serving](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.37989)
*Srikant Bharadwaj,Ankur Mallick,Spyridon Mastorakis,Anjaly Parayil,Dhruv Deshmukh,Victor Ruehle*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: 该研究提出一种面向大语言模型推理的工作负载感知分析与蒙特卡洛模拟器，可预测首个词元生成时间、词元间隔时间的完整分布及可持续请求速率。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 仅用单一吞吐量指标难以支持实际部署决策。推理包含服务特性不同的提示处理与逐词元生成阶段，连续批处理会改变服务过程；此外，用户感知的尾部延迟可能在总体吞吐量达到上限前就已恶化。现有基于单条轨迹回放的模拟也容易低估延迟尾部，且难以评估尚未实际部署的工作负载、路由策略和硬件。

Method: 模拟器为提示处理和逐词元生成阶段分别建立经校准的延迟模型，并结合林德利递推描述随机请求到达下的排队过程。它通过多组蒙特卡洛抽样估算首个词元生成时间、词元间隔时间的完整分布和可持续请求速率，而非仅回放单条请求轨迹；据此分析不同工作负载、路由策略与加速器配置。

Result: 摘要称，该方法能够用于选择运行点、划分流量，并分析最短剩余处理时间调度下的容量问题，也能估计传统轨迹驱动模拟器难以覆盖的延迟尾部。摘要未提供具体实验数值或与基线方法的定量比较。

Conclusion: 该工作提出一种结合分阶段延迟建模、排队分析和蒙特卡洛抽样的推理性能评估框架，旨在为服务等级目标下的容量规划与调度决策提供比单一吞吐量指标和单轨迹回放更全面的依据。

Abstract: Large language model (LLM) inference has become an operational workload that fleets must provision, monitor, and bill against latency service-level objectives (SLOs). A single throughput number cannot answer the questions operators actually face, because generative serving couples two phases with very different service characteristics, continuous batching reshapes the effective service process, and user-visible tail latency can degrade long before aggregate throughput saturates. We present GAUSS, a workload-aware analytical and Monte-Carlo simulator that predicts the full distributions of time-to-first-token (TTFT) and time-between-tokens (TBT), together with the sustainable request rate, for a given workload, engine, and accelerator. GAUSS pairs calibrated, phase-specific latency surfaces for prefill and decode with a Lindley-recurrence model of queueing under stochastic arrivals and estimates performance by ensemble Monte-Carlo sampling rather than by replaying a single trace. This lets GAUSS reason about workloads, routing policies, and hardware that have never been deployed, and to capture the latency tails that trace-driven simulators systematically under-sample. We describe the model and show how it supports operating-point selection, traffic segmentation, and shortest-remaining-processing-time scheduling capacity questions that trace-driven simulators cannot address.

</details>


### [130] [Algorithmic Bias from the Perspectives of Healthcare Professionals](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.38006)
*Jennifer Xu,Tamara Babaian*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: 本研究探讨医疗信息系统中的算法偏差如何影响医疗专业人员对算法公平性的感知，以及他们接受和采用算法及其生成结果的意愿。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 机器学习与人工智能在医疗领域的应用可能产生算法偏差，进而影响公平与平等。由于不同岗位的医疗专业人员承担的任务和视角不同，他们对偏差及其影响的判断可能并不一致，因此有必要了解这些差异。

Method: 研究结合问卷调查的定量数据与访谈的定性意见，收集临床和行政等不同岗位医疗专业人员的看法，并分析算法偏差、公平性感知与接受和采用意愿之间的关系。

Result: 研究发现，医疗专业人员对算法偏差成因、算法评估标准、公平性感知及偏差缓解措施的看法，会因岗位、视角、任务和算法特征而异。

Conclusion: 医疗领域的算法公平问题需要结合使用者的岗位与具体应用情境加以考察。未来仍需开展更多研究，以识别并缓解算法偏差，促进医疗服务中的公平与平等。
