Motivation: 现金流是否具有持续性，是判断小微企业偿付能力的重要依据，但其收入常以含义模糊的转账形式出现，付款记录较短，发生时间又受日历规律影响。传统频域方法可能将这些日历模式视为噪声，难以可靠识别重复现金流，因此需要更准确且可解释的预测方法。

Method: 研究提出日历感知分布式事件网络，将每笔交易视为一个序列标记，使用紧凑型因果变换器预测下一次现金流的金额，以及其发生时间的非参数分布。模型借助外部标注器和冻结的文本编码器继承交易语义，以适应种类繁多的交易对手；同时纳入日历特征，并通过无事件监督提升预测精度。输出的时间分布经过校准，可直接作为下游信贷决策的置信度门控。

Result: 消融实验显示，交易对手语义有助于短历史记录上的召回率，日历输入改善时间预测准确性，无事件监督则提升精确率。与生产环境中的快速傅里叶变换基线相比，模型的一日时间预测准确性提高百分之九十三点三，下一事件的调和平均指标提高百分之六点七。在生产信贷申请的端到端评估中，替换重复现金流特征后，柯尔莫戈罗夫—斯米尔诺夫区分度提高百分之四点八；固定损失率时，审批率提高百分之十八点二；固定审批率时，损失率降低百分之十三点一。

Conclusion: 该方法将交易语义、日历规律与经过校准的事件时间分布结合起来，提升了重复现金流识别和预测效果，并将改进传递到实际信贷决策。其可解释的概率输出也便于接入现有承保模型，支持基于预测置信度进行决策。

Abstract: Recurring cash flows are the backbone of cash-flow underwriting: they separate durable revenue from one-off deposits, expose standing obligations, and ultimately determine ability to pay. For small businesses, recurrence is both indispensable and hard to estimate, because much of their income arrives as ambiguous transfers, most payment streams are short, and schedules follow calendar conventions that frequency-domain methods treat as noise. We present CADENCE, Calendar-Aware Distributional Event Network for Cash-Flow Estimation, a compact causal Transformer that treats each transaction as a token and predicts the amount and a full, nonparametric timing distribution of every cash flow's next payment. Inheriting transaction semantics from an external labeler and a frozen text encoder keeps CADENCE compact yet general across the long tail of small-business counterparties, while predicting a calibrated distribution rather than an opaque embedding makes its outputs interpretable enough to feed existing underwriting models and power credit decisions. Ablations confirm the role of each design choice, with counterparty semantics driving recall on short histories, calendar inputs driving timing accuracy, and no-event supervision driving precision. Against the production FFT baseline, CADENCE improves one-day timing accuracy by 93.3% and next-event F1 by 6.7%, while producing calibrated distributions that serve directly as a confidence gate for downstream decisions. In an end-to-end credit evaluation on production applications, replacing FFT recurrence features with CADENCE features raises KS by 4.8%, raises the approval rate at a fixed loss rate by 18.2%, and lowers the loss rate at a fixed approval rate by 13.1%.

</details>


### [332] [Jailbreak Connectivity: Towards Diverse, Transferable, and Universal Multimodal Large Language Model Jailbreak](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.38091)
*Xu Zhang,Ziqing Hu,Shuo Han,Ren Wang*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 论文提出“越狱连通性”框架，通过探索图像空间中的低损失连续路径，生成多样化且可迁移的视觉越狱输入，并在多种模型和基准测试中取得较高攻击成功率。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有视觉越狱方法多针对单个对抗样例进行优化，因此攻击样式较单一，跨模型迁移能力和面对不同有害请求时的泛化能力有限。论文希望利用有效对抗输入之间可能存在的结构性联系，提升攻击的多样性与普适性，并借此揭示多模态模型安全对齐的薄弱环节。

Method: 该框架将对抗输入的搜索扩展为图像空间中的连续路径优化：从路径上采样以生成多种越狱图像；使用轻量级代理分类器辅助攻击向不同模型迁移；并通过面向输入分布的优化目标，提升攻击对不同有害请求的通用性。

Result: 在多模态安全基准测试中，该方法在三种模型上的平均攻击成功率分别为百分之八十四点零一、百分之八十五点七七和百分之九十七点九五，较最强基线最高提升六十八点三六个百分点。在黑盒测试中，相较于图示步骤基线，该方法在两种模型上的攻击成功率分别提高二十四点六九和二十七点三四个百分点。

Conclusion: 研究表明，有效视觉越狱输入可能并非彼此孤立，而是能够沿低损失区域相连；利用这种结构可增强攻击的多样性、迁移性和通用性。结果提示多模态模型的安全对齐仍存在系统性弱点，也说明安全评估应覆盖更广泛的输入变化与跨模型情境。

Abstract: Multimodal large language models (MLLMs) are vulnerable to visual jailbreak attacks that bypass safety safeguards. Existing methods typically optimize isolated adversarial examples, limiting attack diversity, transferability, and generalization. We propose Jailbreak Connectivity (JC), a framework based on the observation that effective adversarial inputs can be connected through low-loss regions in image space. JC optimizes continuous adversarial paths: path sampling yields diverse jailbreak images, lightweight surrogate classifiers guide cross-model transfer, and a distribution-level objective enables universal attacks across harmful queries. On MM-SafetyBench, JC achieves average attack success rates of 84.01%, 85.77%, and 97.95% on Qwen3-VL-8B-Instruct, InternVL3.5-8B, and Gemma-3-12B-IT, respectively, exceeding the strongest baselines by up to 68.36 percentage points. In black-box evaluations, JC improves attack success rates over FigStep by 24.69 and 27.34 percentage points on GPT-5.6 and Gemini 3.1 Pro, respectively. These findings reveal structured vulnerabilities in MLLM safety alignment and inform more comprehensive security evaluation.

</details>


### [333] [TGTV: An Interpretable Framework for UAV Fault Detection and Traceability via Spatiotemporal Graph Learning and Large Language Models](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.38106)
*Zixuan Wang,Changbo Shi,Ji Liu*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 论文提出一种融合时空图学习与大语言模型的固定翼无人机故障检测和追溯框架，可检测异常并提供可量化、可追溯的诊断依据。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 固定翼无人机运行状态转换、传感器异步采样及控制系统补偿会掩盖故障特征。现有时序检测方法难以刻画跨子系统的耦合故障及其演化，也缺少用定量证据约束语言模型诊断的机制。

Method: 框架先结合时序卷积网络与采用加权融合邻接关系的图注意力网络，提取多尺度时序模式和传感器间空间依赖；再利用时序变换器与变分自编码器，通过预测误差和重构概率评估窗口级异常。连续时间夏普利归因用于识别关键传感器和高贡献时段，并保留故障演化的时间连续性。最后将检测结果、图关系、时序与传感器归因及运行环境整理为结构化证据包，约束大语言模型生成带证据标识的飞行级诊断结论。

Result: 在公开固定翼飞行数据集上进行跨飞行留出实验，窗口级精确率—召回率曲线下面积为0.976，准确率为0.973，召回率为0.902，调和平均值为0.920；飞行级故障诊断的召回率为0.943，调和平均值为0.944。

Conclusion: 实验结果表明，该框架能够实现较准确的异常检测，并提供有定量依据的故障追溯线索，可支持可解释的飞行后故障复核与分析。

Abstract: Fixed-wing unmanned aerial vehicles experience operating-condition transitions, asynchronous sensor sampling, and control-system compensation that can obscure fault signatures. Existing temporal detection methods have limited capacity to represent coupled faults across subsystems, track their evolution, and constrain language-model diagnoses with quantitative evidence. This paper proposes TGTV, an interpretable fault detection and traceability framework that integrates spatiotemporal graph learning with a large language model. A temporal convolutional network and a graph attention network with weighted fused adjacency extract multiscale temporal patterns and spatial dependencies among sensors. A hybrid temporal Transformer and variational autoencoder then evaluates window-level anomalies using prediction errors and reconstruction probabilities. Continuous-time Shapley attribution identifies critical sensors and high-contribution intervals while preserving the temporal continuity of fault evolution. A structured evidence package combines detection results, graph relationships, temporal attribution, sensor attribution, and operating context. An evidence-constrained diagnosis protocol uses this package to generate flight-level conclusions with traceable evidence identifiers. Cross-flight holdout experiments on the public ALFA fixed-wing flight dataset yield a window-level area under the precision-recall curve of 0.976, accuracy of 0.973, recall of 0.902, and F1 score of 0.920. Flight-level fault diagnosis achieves recall of 0.943 and an F1 score of 0.944. These results demonstrate accurate anomaly detection and quantitatively supported fault-tracing cues, providing a basis for interpretable post-flight fault review and analysis.

</details>


### [334] [A Separation Principle for Adversarial Attacks and Defense of Graph Neural Networks](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.38127)
*Farid Mafi,Saber Jafarpour,Mohammad Pirani*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 论文提出一种基于图结构谱性质的特征攻击方法：在特定目标松弛条件下，最优扰动可分解为仅由图决定的节点分配部分和仅由模型权重决定的特征方向部分；据此构造的攻击无需计算梯度，并进一步用于设计对抗训练方法。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 既有图神经网络对抗攻击大多从模型优化角度出发，将图视为被动载体，因而可能忽略消息传递机制与图结构本身对脆弱性的影响。论文旨在揭示图结构如何决定特征扰动的空间分布，并据此构建更高效、可解释的攻击方法。

Method: 作者从归一化邻接算子的谱性质出发，建立结构驱动的特征攻击框架。其核心分离原理表明，在对攻击目标进行自然松弛后，最优特征扰动为秩一形式：一部分由图结构决定，按节点度数比例分配扰动；另一部分由模型权重决定，为组合权重矩阵的最大奇异向量。基于该闭式结果，作者提出无需梯度计算的“分离攻击”，并进一步构造“分离式对抗训练”。

Result: 实验表明，分离攻击在目标攻击任务中对既有基线具有有竞争力或更优的表现，速度最高约快七十倍。在连续特征图上，由于其图结构部分不依赖具体模型架构，该攻击在不同架构间具有近乎完美的迁移性。作者还报告，分离式对抗训练能提升二值特征基准上的鲁棒性。

Conclusion: 论文指出，节点度数是影响图神经网络抵御特征扰动能力的关键图结构因素，并证明攻击扰动可在图结构与模型权重之间实现解析分离。这一发现为高效、可解释且具有跨架构迁移性的图对抗攻击及相应防御训练提供了依据。

Abstract: Adversarial attacks on graph neural networks (GNNs) have been studied as a model-centric optimization problem driven by gradients, learned policies, or meta-learning, with the graph treated as a passive substrate. This view overlooks a defining feature of GNNs: their predictions are produced by structured message passing along the graph, so their adversarial vulnerabilities are encoded as much in the geometry of the graph as in the learned weights. We develop a structure-driven framework for feature attacks in which the attack is derived from the spectral properties of the normalized adjacency operator. Its central result is a separation principle: under a natural relaxation of the attack objective, the optimal feature perturbation is rank one and factorizes into a graph-dependent component (degree-proportional spatial allocation, depending only on the graph) and a weight-dependent component (top singular vector of the composed weights, depending only on the weights). Node degree thus emerges as the fundamental graph quantity governing adversarial vulnerability to feature perturbations. The resulting attack, which we call SepAttack, requires no gradient computation, carries analytical guarantees, achieves competitive or superior performance against established baselines such as Nettack and IG-Attack with up to ${\sim}70\times$ speedup in the targeted setting, and transfers near-perfectly across architectures on continuous-feature graphs because its graph-dependent component is architecture-invariant by construction. We further derive a separation-principle adversarial training procedure (SepAT) directly from the closed-form worst-case attack and report robustness gains on binary-feature benchmarks.

</details>


### [335] [Estimating Implicit Expected Log Density Ratios](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.38151)
*Avi Amalanshu,Chandler Squires,Yizhou Lu,Pradeep Ravikumar*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 论文提出“期望对数密度比”这一问题，指出许多看似密度比估计的任务实质上是在第三种分布下对数密度比的积分估计；常规方法可能并不适用，纳入来自积分分布的样本则有助于提升估计效果。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 当概率密度无法精确计算时，密度比估计常用于实验设计、生成建模和强化学习等任务。然而，许多应用需要的并非密度比本身，而是在另一种可能不同的分布下，对数密度比的期望。若忽略这一差异并直接套用常规密度比估计方法，可能会导致方法选择不当；同时，这类期望量的有限样本估计能力也存在根本限制。

Method: 论文定义了期望对数密度比，并分析其与常规密度比估计任务的区别，证明了有限样本条件下估计该量的基本限制。基于此，作者提出对部分密度比估计方法进行简单改造：将趋近于积分所用分布的样本纳入训练数据，以适配期望对数密度比的估计需求。

Result: 理论分析表明，许多涉及隐式密度的问题实际上属于期望对数密度比估计，常规密度比估计方法并不适合直接解决这些问题。基准实验显示，纳入与积分分布相匹配的训练样本后，期望对数密度比的估计误差可以降低。

Conclusion: 期望对数密度比是区别于常规密度比估计的重要问题类别，不能默认沿用传统方法。论文通过理论限制分析和初步实验，论证了发展专门估计器的必要性，并展示了针对训练数据进行改造的一种可行方向。

Abstract: When exact probabilities cannot be computed, \emph{density ratio estimation (DRE)} is a key subroutine in the wide range of applications where density ratios appear, from experimental design to generative modelling and reinforcement learning. In this paper, we introduce the concept of an \emph{expected log density ratio (ELDR)}: log density ratios that are integrated under some third, possibly distinct measure. We show many problems with implicit densities where DRE is naïvely used are actually ELDR estimation tasks, and prove fundamental limitations on finite-sample ELDR estimation. Based on these results, we argue that the typical DRE-based approaches are unsuitable for ELDR estimation, and provide some foundational motivation towards bespoke ELDR estimators. To demonstrate, we propose a simple modification to some DRE methods that allows samples convergent to the integral distribution to appear in training data. We show through benchmarks that this can improve ELDR estimation error.

</details>


### [336] [MASS: Multi-mask Selective Self-Distillation for Leakage-Resilient Reasoning](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.38154)
*Xiuqi Liu,Oveys Delafrooz Noroozi,Upamanyu Madhow*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 该方法通过对同一份经验证的解答生成多个独立遮蔽视图，汇总教师的互补预测，并有选择地向学生传递可靠的逐词修正，从而提升自蒸馏效果。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 在线自蒸馏让同一模型兼任教师和学生，教师可利用特权信息提供细粒度监督。但若教师只依赖单一参考解答，其预测可能过度集中于一条推理路径，限制知识向学生迁移。

Method: 多遮蔽选择性自蒸馏通过对一份已验证解答进行多次独立遮蔽，近似刻画不同参考实现所形成的预测分布。方法汇总多个互补的教师预测，仅传递可靠的逐词修正，并根据参考片段的重要性自适应地调整遮蔽重点。

Result: 在数学推理基准和多种模型系列上的实验表明，该方法持续优于有竞争力的自蒸馏基线。摘要未提供具体数据或显著性检验结果。

Conclusion: 利用多种遮蔽视图缓解单一参考带来的推理路径偏置，并结合可靠性筛选与重点片段遮蔽，可以增强在线自蒸馏的知识迁移效果。

Abstract: On-policy self-distillation enables the same model to act as student and teacher, with dense token-level supervision obtained by the teacher being given access to privileged information. However, conditioning the teacher on a single reference can concentrate its predictions on one reasoning trajectory and limit transfer to the student. We propose Multi-Mask Selective Self-Distillation (MASS), which approximates the unavailable marginal over diverse reference realizations using multiple independently masked views of one verified solution. MASS aggregates these complementary teacher predictions, selectively transfers reliable token-level corrections, and adaptively focuses masking on influential reference spans. Across mathematical reasoning benchmarks and model families, MASS consistently outperforms strong self-distillation baselines.

</details>


### [337] [Floor It, Then Fill It: Simulating Creator Ecosystems for Fair Video-Content Recommendation Systems at Billion User Scale](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.38155)
*Sohini Roychowdhury,Long Sha,Sunand Agarwal,Payal Kamboj,Shuyang Chen,Junlin Zhang,Scott Chen,Hui Zhang*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 论文构建了贴近真实平台的创作者—观众生态模拟器，用于评估公平分配推荐曝光的策略；结果显示，设置最低保障并缩小曝光差距，可稳定达成大多数创作者的曝光目标，并提升小创作者自然触达。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 以互动量为优化目标的推荐系统容易形成“强者愈强”的循环，使新兴创作者在大型平台上处于结构性劣势。要在大规模环境中评估公平干预，需要能够真实反映创作者差异、成长过程及观众互动的模拟器；但现有模拟器的真实性、多样性和有效性尚未得到充分研究。

Method: 作者提出一个基于真实平台数据校准的模拟框架，模拟约四万二千名创作者及其相互关联的观众互动，覆盖十二周。框架从三个方面建模与验证：依据真实创作者分布进行聚类，以体现创作者多样性；通过相互耦合的创作者与内容状态机，描述成长轨迹、互动积累和晋级过程；并利用平台实际指标校准模拟结果，以检验群体层面的有效性。随后，作者将公平曝光分配设定为带预算约束的多臂老虎机问题，比较不同内容观看目标定义、奖励函数及小创作者预留曝光机制。

Result: 带有最低保障的逐内容观看目标，并采用缩小观看量差距的奖励函数时，每周至少有百分之九十的观看目标能够由创作者达成；小创作者的自然触达每周增长约百分之三十三。获得曝光的创作者集合也较稳定，其周际交并比为零点八一九。论文还分析了模拟结果与真实平台之间的差距，并提出相应的验证流程。

Conclusion: 研究表明，经过真实数据校准、具备创作者异质性和行为动态的模拟器，可用于比较公平推荐策略，但模拟得出的公平性结论仍需结合模拟与现实之间的差距审慎解读。通过最低曝光保障和差距导向的奖励机制，平台可以在提升小创作者触达的同时维持较稳定的曝光分配。

Abstract: Engagement-optimized content recommendation systems exhibit a well-documented rich-get-richer dynamic that structurally disadvantages emerging creators on large-scale platforms. Evaluating debiasing interventions at scale demands faithful simulation of creator-viewer ecosystems, yet the fidelity, diversity, and validity of such simulators remain underexplored. We present a grounded user-simulation framework that models a heterogeneous population of ${\sim}42$K creators and their coupled viewer interactions over 12~weeks, and use it to evaluate equitable view-allocation policies formulated as a budgeted multi-armed bandit (MAB). The simulator captures three behavioral dimensions: (i)~\textbf{creator diversity}, modeled via a clustering approach grounded in real platform creator-level distributions; (ii)~\textbf{behavioral fidelity}, captured through coupled creator-content state machines that represent growth trajectories, engagement accumulation, and graduation dynamics; and (iii)~\textbf{population-level validity}, measured by calibration against observed platform metrics. We evaluate simulative-configurations that vary content-viewership target definitions, reward functions, and a small-creator reserve lever to maximize creator-content recommendation equity. A floor-protected per content-view-target with a view-parity-gap reward guarantees 90\% of view targets being met by creators every week, grows small-creator organic reach ${\sim}{+}33\%$ per week, and achieves high distribution stability (set of creators with funded-views Jaccard $= 0.819$). We analyze the Sim2Real gap and propose validation protocols, contributing evidence for when simulation-derived fairness conclusions can be trusted.

</details>


### [338] [Replaying the Same Gradients at a Different $\varepsilon$: A Registered Test of the Fixed-Trajectory Account of Adam's $\varepsilon$ for One Rare Row](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.38169)
*Lngel Kyo*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 研究发现，在一个小型因果变换器中，大幅提高稀有词输出嵌入行的稳定常数后，基于原训练轨迹的简单算术重放会明显低估该行的实际位移；结论仅限于所测试的模型、语料和嵌入行。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 自适应矩估计算法会用平方梯度滑动平均的平方根加上稳定常数，再对每步更新进行缩放。对于出现频率很低的词，其输出嵌入行的更新可能主要受这一分母影响，因此提高稳定常数似乎可以仅凭算术解释为缩小该行的步长。论文直接检验这一解释是否能预测该行的实际变化。

Method: 研究者在训练过程中，利用该次运行实际产生的梯度和矩估计，对目标嵌入行的更新改用不同的稳定常数进行重放，从而固定训练轨迹，单独检验算术缩放能否预测位移。研究事先规定了判定重放预测错误的标准，并使用采样负例输出头作为主要测量工具、完整归一化输出头作为第二种测量工具。另进行真实训练运行，分别只调整目标行、只调整其他参数，或只改变目标行学习率，以检验相关解释。

Result: 稳定常数提高一万倍时，预先登记的三个随机种子在两种输出头下都判定重放预测错误：目标行保留的位移分别是重放预测值的八点九至十一点四倍、五点零至七点七倍。提高一千倍时，主要输出头上的结果以较小幅度未达到预设错误标准；之后登记并单独评估的另外两个种子也呈现相同模式。真实运行显示，只提高目标行的稳定常数足以复现其变化，只提高其他参数的稳定常数也会使该行部分移动；这些结果都不能挽救重放解释。单独缩放目标行学习率时，重放也沿相同方向出现误判。

Conclusion: 在所研究的条件下，目标嵌入行的变化不能仅由固定训练轨迹上的分母缩放来解释，其他参数的训练变化也可能影响该行。证据支持的是一个特定模型家族、单一语料和单个嵌入行上的有限结论；论文不据此推断一般变化率、其他嵌入行的普遍规律，或模型规模变化带来的影响。

Abstract: Adam divides every update by the square root of a running average of squared gradients plus a small constant, epsilon. For an output-embedding row whose token is rare, which we call the probe row, raising epsilon can be read as shrinking that row's steps by arithmetic alone. We test that reading directly. While a training run proceeds, we also divide the probe row's update by a different epsilon, using the run's own moment estimates; this replay is exact arithmetic on the gradients the run actually saw, so it holds the run's trajectory fixed. A rule for when the replay counts as wrong was written down before the runs.
  We train a small causal transformer in a standard configuration. When epsilon rises by four orders of magnitude, the replay counts as wrong on each of the three seeds registered for the test: the probe row keeps 8.9--11.4 times more of its displacement than predicted with the main, sampled-negative head, and 5.0--7.7 times more with a full-softmax head scored as a second instrument. At three orders of magnitude, tested with the main head only, it does not, by narrow margins; a further two seeds, registered after this result had been committed and scored on their own, follow the same pattern. In separate real runs, raising epsilon on the probe row alone is enough to reproduce the row's change and raising it on every other parameter alone also moves the row part of the way --- readings about the runs that do not rescue the replay; scaling the row's learning rate instead, with the denominator untouched, is mispredicted by the replay in the same direction.
  This is one embedding row of one model family on one corpus; we make no claim about rates, about rows in general (other rows were read only as a panel on one trajectory) or about how the effect changes with model size.

</details>


### [339] [B2P-Corr: Batch-to-Population Gradient Estimators for Non-Decomposable Correlation Losses](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.38171)
*Jingquan Yan,Yuwei Miao,Peiran Yu,Junzhou Huang*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 论文提出一种利用全局矩统计草图，将相关性目标转化为可分解伪损失的方法，以缩小小批量训练与总体优化之间的差距，并在较低计算开销下提升训练稳定性和相关性表现。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 皮尔逊相关系数和一致性相关系数依赖数据集层面的均值、方差与协方差，无法直接分解到单个样本。使用小批量局部统计量进行随机优化，会造成梯度有偏且方差较大，使其期望偏离总体梯度，进而影响优化稳定性与最终性能。

Method: 提出基于全局矩统计草图的相关性优化框架，并设计两种线性开销变体。第一种通过指数移动平均估计全局统计量，并结合停止梯度操作，在小批量开销下实现渐近梯度跟踪。第二种采用跨批次抽样的尤统计量估计，并通过蓄水池机制稳定估计，同样将实现开销控制在与批量大小线性相关的水平。

Result: 理论分析量化了朴素小批量优化的偏差为批量大小倒数阶；还证明了在统计草图更新较快、模型参数更新较慢时，移动平均方法能够跟踪变化目标，并对尤统计量方法给出了理想化控制变量分析。两组合成数据和三组真实数据实验显示，该框架优化更稳定，所得相关性高于朴素小批量方法，且额外开销可忽略。

Conclusion: 该研究针对相关性指标不可分解、难以直接进行随机优化的问题，提出了基于全局矩统计量的轻量级解决方案。理论与实验结果表明，这类方法能够缓解小批量统计带来的偏差和不稳定性，在保持低开销的同时改善相关性目标的优化效果。

Abstract: Correlation metrics such as the Pearson Correlation Coefficient (PCC) and Concordance Correlation Coefficient (CCC) are standard regression metrics and learning objectives, but their non-decomposable nature poses a challenge for stochastic optimization. Since these metrics depend on dataset-level moments (mean, variance, covariance), naive mini-batch training with local statistics yields biased, high-variance gradients whose expectation does not align with the population gradient. To bridge this ``batch-to-population'' (B2P) gap, we propose \textbf{B2P-Corr}, a novel framework that transforms correlation objectives into decomposable pseudo-losses driven by lightweight global ``moment sketches''. We introduce two efficient variants: \textbf{B2P-EMA}, which utilizes exponential moving averages and stop-gradient operators to ensure asymptotic gradient tracking with $O(B)$ cost ($B$ is batch size); and \textbf{B2P-U}, which uses sampled cross-batch U-statistic estimators and a reservoir-based stabilization with an $O(B)$ implementation. Theoretically, we quantify the $O(B^{-1})$ bias of naive mini-batch optimization, prove a moving-target tracking result for B2P-EMA under a fast-sketch / slow-parameter regime, and provide an idealized control-variate analysis for B2P-U. Experiments on two synthetic and three real-world datasets demonstrate B2P-Corr achieves stable optimization and higher correlation than naive mini-batch optimization with negligible overhead.

</details>


### [340] [Data Amount Heterogeneity Improves Performance in Federated Learning for Neuroimaging](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.38172)
*Paul Kurian,Tamoghna Chattopadhyay,Abhijith Shaji,Greg Ver Steeg,Paul M. Thompson,Jose Luis Ambite*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 研究发现，联邦学习中由一个大型数据站点和多个小型站点组成的异质联邦，尤其在数据有限时，通常优于各站点数据量相近的同质联邦，并能接近集中式训练的表现。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 大型神经影像协作项目中的参与站点往往拥有差异很大的数据量，小型站点的数据较少是常见情况。研究旨在考察这种数据量不均衡如何影响联邦学习效果，以及如何更有效地利用小型站点的数据。

Method: 研究比较了不同站点数据量分布下的联邦学习表现，重点考察由一个大型站点与多个小型站点构成的异质联邦，并与各站点数据量相同的同质联邦及集中式训练进行比较。联邦学习过程中，各站点在本地训练模型，通过加密方式汇总模型参数，并将聚合模型返回各站点继续训练。

Result: 异质联邦整体表现优于同质联邦，这一优势在数据量较少的情形下尤为明显。大型站点通常能加快模型收敛并提升最终准确率；异质联邦也能更有效地利用小型站点的数据，且总体表现接近集中式训练。

Conclusion: 联邦学习中的站点数据量不必相同。对于数据规模差异明显的大型协作项目，包含大型站点和小型站点的异质配置可能比均衡配置更有效，同时保留数据不出站点的隐私保护优势。

Abstract: Federated Learning (FL) allows for secure analysis of distributed data without data sharing. We and others have successfully applied FL to neuroimaging tasks, such as Alzheimer's disease classification from structural magnetic resonance imaging (MRI). FL trains a deep learning model locally at each site, encrypts the local model parameters and sends them to a federation controller that aggregates the local models under homomorphic encryption, the resulting community model is sent back to the sites for further training, and the process repeats for a number of rounds. FL often achieves learning performance (e.g., accuracy) close to centralized training, but no data leaves the sites and model parameters are protected through encryption and other measures.
  In this paper, we show that federations composed of sites with heterogeneous amounts of data (1 large site plus small sites) perform better than homogeneous (same data per site) federations, particularly in low data regimes, while reaching performance close to centralized training. Having a big site often results in faster convergence and higher final accuracy. Heterogeneous federations better exploit sites with small amounts of data, a common situation in large consortia such as ENIGMA.

</details>


### [341] [A Gradient based Adversarial Augmentation Framework for Mitigating Unlearnable Datasets](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.38173)
*Long Dang,Satpal Sura,Kaiqi Xiong*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 本文提出一种基于梯度的对抗式数据增强方法，可高效搜索增强策略，检验并提升对不可学习数据保护方法的抵抗能力。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 不可学习数据保护通过添加难以察觉的扰动，使模型依赖捷径而非可泛化特征进行训练。对扰动图像施加能显著增加训练损失的对抗性增强，有望迫使模型学习更具泛化性的特征。已有方法依赖随机采样或启发式搜索增强操作，候选操作较多时效率和可扩展性不足。

Method: 提出一种基于梯度上升学习增强策略的框架。该方法使用可微数据增强流程，在最多十八种增强操作中高效搜索，并通过网格搜索选出适用于特定保护方法的操作子集；随后训练该子集以最大化代理模型的分类损失。为避免增强破坏图像语义，还引入结合感知差异与像素差异的正则化，以优化操作参数。

Result: 受控消融实验显示，梯度引导策略 consistently 优于使用相同候选范围的随机采样基线：在经过一种保护方法处理的十分类数据集上，残差网络的干净测试准确率为百分之八十，而基线为百分之七十七点二九；在另一种保护方法处理的数据集上，轻量级卷积网络的准确率为百分之八十三点二八，而基线为百分之六十六点四五。结果表明，性能提升主要来自梯度引导，而非仅仅扩大搜索空间。

Conclusion: 该框架提供了一种有效且可扩展的对抗式数据增强方案，可用于压力测试不可学习数据保护方法，并帮助研究者发现其弱点、开发更稳健的保护技术。

Abstract: Unlearnable data methods (ULD) protect public data from unauthorized model training by adding imperceptible perturbations that create a learning shortcut. A deep neural network can exploit the shortcut learning path to minimize training loss without learning generalizable features. Intuitively, finding adversarial versions of perturbed images that can substantially increase the model's loss can force the model to learn generalizable features. Existing data augmentation based attacks rely on heuristic search strategies/random sampling over a curated augmentation set to identify adversarial augmentation operations, an approach that often does not scale when the number of candidate operations is large. To address the challenge of a large search space, we propose {\techname}, a gradient based adversarial augmentation framework that learns an augmentation policy via stochastic gradient ascent. {\techname} leverages a differentiable data augmentation pipeline to efficiently search a set of up to 18 augmentation techniques, from which a grid search selects a protection-specific subset. The augmentation subset is trained to maximize a surrogate model's classification loss. We introduce a perceptual-plus-pixel regularization to learn operation parameters that preserve image semantics. Under a controlled ablation, {\techname} consistently outperforms an equivalent random sampling baseline (80.0\% vs. 77.29\% clean test accuracy on EMIN-protected CIFAR-10 for ResNet-18 and 83.28\% vs. 66.45\% on NTGA-protected CIFAR-10 for MobileNet-V2), demonstrating that gradient guidance drives the clean test accuracy recoverability rather than the expanded search space. {\techname} offers an effective and scalable adversarial augmentation framework for stress-testing ULD methods, a critical tool for developing robust ULD methods.

</details>


### [342] [Convex-SKM-Net: Low-Latency Block Halfspace Corrections for Neural Convex Constraint Satisfaction](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.38197)
*Haoyu Zhu,Xiaochen Zhang,Qingchun Hou*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 提出凸约束满足网络，通过固定深度的对偶投影梯度计算快速修正，并联合学习预测器与正定移动矩阵；实验中测试输出均满足严格可行性要求，推理速度最高提升约一百四十四倍。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 学习型决策方法需要兼顾快速推理与严格满足约束。现有方法常依赖针对特定约束设计的投影算子或可行域参数化，而迭代式修复可能计算昂贵，因此需要一种通用、易于并行且能高效保证可行性的约束处理方法。

Method: 提出凸约束满足网络：利用约束残差及其梯度或次梯度构造线性化半空间，无须专门的约束不等式投影算子；对最小位移分块问题执行固定深度的对偶投影梯度迭代，并采用适合图形处理器的矩阵运算。方法还联合训练预测器和正定移动矩阵，以调整修正几何、改善目标函数质量。理论上证明了固定对偶迭代深度下外层迭代的收敛性，并在满足斯莱特条件且次梯度有界时证明了迭代点到可行解集的距离线性收敛。

Result: 在三个二阶锥模型预测控制时域和六个电力系统凸松弛问题中，所有测试输出的可行性误差均不超过十的负三次方。相较最新约束满足方法，在二阶锥模型预测控制任务上的推理速度最高提升一百四十四点三倍；在联合训练的凸二次约束二次规划基准上最高提升七点七倍。该基准的平均目标差距为百分之零点零一二，全部测试样本均满足十的负四次方可行性要求。学习移动矩阵使五个随机种子的仿射任务平均目标差距降低百分之二十二点四，并改善了匹配的电力系统任务表现。

Conclusion: 该方法将通用的半空间构造、有限步对偶优化与可学习的修正几何结合，在严格可行性、推理效率和目标质量之间取得了良好平衡。理论分析与多类控制及电力系统实验共同表明，它是无需约束专用投影器的有效约束满足方案。

Abstract: Fast inference and strict constraint satisfaction are essential for learning-based decision-making. Existing methods often rely on constraint-specific projections or feasible-set parameterizations, while iterative repair can be costly. We introduce Convex-SKM-Net, a convex constraint-satisfaction layer that forms linearization halfspaces from residual and (sub)gradient oracles without constraint-specific inequality projectors. It applies fixed-depth dual projected-gradient descent (dual PGD) to minimum-displacement block problems using GPU-friendly matrix operations. We jointly learn the predictor and a positive-definite mobility, adapting the correction geometry to improve objective quality. We prove convergence of the outer iterates at fixed dual depth and linear convergence in distance under Slater's condition and bounded subgradients. All our test outputs on three second-order-cone model-predictive control (SOC-MPC) horizons and six power-system convex relaxations satisfy a $10^{-3}$ feasibility tolerance. Comparisons with the latest constraint-satisfaction methods show inference speedups of up to $144.3\times$ on SOC-MPC and $7.7\times$ on a convex quadratically constrained quadratic programming (QCQP) benchmark with joint training. On QCQP, the mean objective gap is $0.012\%$, with full test feasibility at $10^{-4}$. Learning mobility reduces the five-seed affine-task mean gap by $22.4\%$ and improves gaps in matched power-system comparisons.

</details>


### [343] [Averaged Annealed Markov Chains Achieve the Algorithmic Threshold for Tensor PCA, Part II: Langevin Dynamics](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.38206)
*Aniket Das,Tselil Schramm*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 论文表明，结合退火与遍历平均的球面朗之万动力学，能够从均匀随机初始化出发，在多项式时间内实现张量主成分分析的强恢复，并达到已知的算法阈值。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 张量主成分分析存在信息与计算之间的差距：谱方法、平方和等全局算法可在算法阈值以上恢复信号，而此前已知的局部马尔可夫链方法从随机初始化出发，需要显著更强的信噪比。因此，人们认为局部算法不如全局算法。论文旨在缩小这一差距，检验局部动力学能否达到算法阈值。

Method: 研究对象是在球面上恢复未知向量的问题：观测是该向量的第 k 次张量幂的带噪版本，其中 k 为固定且不小于三的整数。作者采用球面朗之万动力学，并结合退火策略与遍历平均，使算法从均匀随机初始化出发，在多项式时间内进行恢复。

Result: 论文证明，在算法阈值以上，所提出的方法能够从无信息的均匀随机初始点实现强恢复，且运行时间为多项式级。结合前篇成果，这表明局部马尔可夫链方法无需更高的信噪比，也能从冷启动达到算法阈值。

Conclusion: 研究结果挑战了局部算法必然弱于全局算法的既有认识：经过退火和遍历平均，球面朗之万动力学可以从随机初始化出发，在算法阈值处实现张量主成分分析的强恢复。

Abstract: We consider the tensor principal components analysis (tensor PCA) problem on the sphere, in which we are asked to recover an unknown vector in $\mathcal{S}_N=\{x\in\mathbb{R}^N:\lVert x\rVert^2=N\}$ from a noisy observation of its $k$-th tensor power, for a fixed $k\ge3$. Tensor PCA exhibits a well-studied information-computation gap: global algorithms such as spectral methods and sum-of-squares work above an algorithmic threshold, below which we know matching lower bounds (against these and some other restricted models of computation). In contrast, local algorithms such as Markov chains were only known to succeed from a random initialization at a polynomially larger signal-to-noise ratio, and were believed to be inferior to global algorithms for tensor PCA. Continuing the program initiated in Part I [arXiv:2610.16705], we show that spherical Langevin dynamics, when supplemented with annealing and ergodic averaging, achieves polynomial-time strong recovery above the algorithmic threshold from a uniformly random initialization. Together with Part I, our results demonstrate that local Markov chains can succeed all the way down to the algorithmic threshold from an uninformative cold start.

</details>


### [344] [Progressive Coupling Method for Diffusion Posterior Sampling in Ptychography](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.38207)
*Yihan Qiu,Mingtao Huang,Tianyuan Li,Shudong Li,Yuan Shen*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 本文提出渐进式耦合后验采样方法，在扫描重叠度较低、测量约束较弱时利用扩散模型先验提升相干衍射成像重建精度。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 相干衍射成像依赖重叠测量提供冗余信息，以实现稳健重建；但密集扫描会增加采集时间和数据量。减少扫描重叠虽能提高效率，却会削弱重建所需的物理约束。如何在约束较弱时有效利用扩散模型提供的先验信息，是需要解决的关键问题。

Method: 提出渐进式耦合后验采样方法。在重建不确定性较高时，该方法允许更广泛地探索可能解；随着重建逐步细化，则增强扩散模型引导下的一致性，从而平衡解空间探索与先验约束。

Result: 基于不同扫描重叠度下的真实Ｘ射线相干衍射成像数据进行实验。结果显示，该方法相较于传统迭代方法和已有扩散后验采样方法，能够持续提高重建精度；在低重叠度条件下，优势尤为明显。

Conclusion: 渐进式调节解空间探索与扩散先验约束，有助于在测量冗余较少时仍实现准确重建。研究表明，扩散模型先验有望降低相干衍射成像对测量重叠冗余的需求。

Abstract: Ptychography is a computational imaging method that reconstructs a sample from overlapping diffraction measurements. This technique relies on these overlapping measurements to provide the redundancy information needed for robust reconstruction, but dense scanning increases acquisition time and data volume. Reducing scan overlaps can improve measurement efficiency but weakens the physical constraints available for reconstruction. Diffusion models provide strong learned prior information, offering a promising approach to compensate for the loss of measurement redundancy. However, effectively utilizing this prior information under weak measurement constraints remains a challenge. We propose a progressive coupling posterior sampling (PCPS) method, which allows for a broader exploration of the solution space under high uncertainty while maintaining stronger diffusion-guided consistency as the reconstruction becomes more refined. Experiments on real X-ray ptychographic data at various scan overlaps demonstrate that PCPS consistently improves reconstruction accuracy compared to traditional iterative methods and existing diffusion posterior samplers, especially at low overlaps. These results show that diffusion priors can reduce the measurement redundancy required for accurate ptychography reconstruction.

</details>


### [345] [RainCheck: Harnessing Historical Weather Data with Machine Learning for Rainfall Forecasting in Bangladesh](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.38211)
*Shahran Rahman Alve,Muhammad Zawad Mahmud,Samiha Islam,Al Jubayer Pial*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 研究表明，随机划分会高估降雨预测能力；在未见年份上与气候基准比较，机器学习模型的增益有限，且主要局限于短期预测。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 降雨预测研究常将站点记录随机分为训练集和测试集，这可能造成信息泄漏：模型训练时已接触邻近站点同一天的降雨信息，也可能借助季节规律获得看似很高的成绩。因此，论文旨在检验评估划分方式和特征选择如何影响模型表现，并确认模型是否真正优于简单的气候基准。

Method: 研究使用孟加拉国气象部门35个站点在1948至2014年的618650个站点日记录，比较随机划分、按时间划分和同时留出站点与年份的时空划分。模型采用仅含日历信息或加入前期降雨信息的特征，并将六种学习算法与气候基准、持续性预测及季节性自回归综合移动平均模型进行比较；评估对象包括高降雨月份分类、次日降雨预测和月降雨总量预测。

Result: 仅使用站点和月份气候规律的基准，对高降雨月份的分类准确率为88.4%，曲线下面积为0.950；在按时间划分的评估中，没有学习模型的表现比它高出超过0.8个百分点。仅用日历特征的随机森林在随机划分下，次日是否降雨预测的曲线下面积达到0.889，但在未来年份测试中降至0.835，低于气候基准的0.859。加入滞后降雨后，次日预测获得有限但真实的提升，相对于气候基准的布里尔技巧分数为0.074；移除站点和年份特征后升至0.091，加入其他站点当天观测后升至0.131。门控循环单元序列模型不优于梯度提升模型，预测技巧在提前两天以上时消失；月总量预测中，没有学习模型显著优于气候基准。

Conclusion: 随机划分可能因时空信息泄漏和季节规律而夸大降雨预测能力。可靠评估应在未见年份上测试，并将结果与气候基准比较。滞后降雨信息能带来有限的次日预测收益，但长期预测和月总量预测尚无显著优势。论文同时发布了考虑信息泄漏的评估方案及代码，以促进后续研究采用更可信的验证方法。

Abstract: Machine-learning rainfall forecasts are often evaluated by shuffling station records into random training and test sets. For rainfall, this lets a model see what happened at neighbouring stations on the very day it is asked to forecast, and it hides the fact that a seasonal lookup table already explains most of the variance. We quantify both effects on 618,650 station-days from 35 Bangladesh Meteorological Department stations (1948-2014). We compare random, temporal (train <=1999, test 2005-2014) and spatio-temporal (unseen stations and unseen years) evaluation, calendar-only versus antecedent-rainfall features, and six learners against climatology, persistence and SARIMA. Three findings stand out. First, a station-month climatology alone classifies high-rainfall months with 88.4% accuracy (AUC 0.950), and no learner improved on it by more than 0.8 points under temporal evaluation. Second, a calendar-only random forest reached a next-day wet-day AUC of 0.889 under a random split, higher than any model with real predictors under temporal evaluation, yet fell to 0.835, below climatology (0.859), on future years. Third, models with lagged rainfall add genuine but modest skill for next-day forecasts: a Brier skill score of 0.074 (95% CI 0.064-0.088) over climatology, rising to 0.091 when station and year inputs are removed and to 0.131 when other stations' same-day observations are added. A GRU sequence model matches but does not exceed gradient boosting, and skill disappears beyond a two-day lead. For monthly totals, no learner beat climatology significantly. We release a leakage-aware protocol and code so that future station-based studies report skill against climatology on held-out years.

</details>


### [346] [HotPOT: Operator Transformer with Heterogeneous Physics Experts for Large-Scale PDE Pre-training](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.38218)
*Jiayi Li,Guancheng Zhou,Yisi Luo,Ruihua Chen,Penghao Jiang,Deyu Meng,Flora D. Salim,Piotr Koniusz*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 本文提出一种面向多类偏微分方程预训练的异构专家模型，通过共享编码器与各方程族专属的神经—数值专家协同建模，提升预测精度并减少跨任务干扰。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 大规模偏微分方程预训练将多种方程的数据用于训练同一模型，但不同方程的控制规律、物理变量及变量间作用存在差异，混合训练未必能提升所有任务的性能。已有专家混合模型虽可通过路由缓解任务干扰，却通常采用结构相同的专家，难以体现不同方程状态演化方式的差别。

Method: 方法采用共享编码器提取不同偏微分方程之间的共性信息，并为每类方程配置专属的神经—数值专家。每个专家由可学习的预测器和不含可训练参数的固定数值更新组成：预测器输出对应数值更新所需的物理量，再由数值更新计算下一时刻状态。这样既共享通用表示，也保留各方程专属的预测机制与更新规则。

Result: 在五类偏微分方程、六种实验设置下，该方法在与基线模型规模匹配的二十四项比较中，无论微调前后均取得更好表现，滚动预测误差平均降低百分之五十点七。仅有一千七百万参数的模型也超过了参数规模显著更大的基线模型；在未见过的物理条件下进行零样本预测时，性能优势仍然存在。

Conclusion: 研究表明，将共享表示学习与方程专属的神经预测器、固定数值更新相结合，可有效利用多类偏微分方程数据，同时适应不同方程的演化规律。该设计在预测精度、参数效率及未见条件下的泛化方面均展现出优势。

Abstract: Large-scale PDE pre-training trains a single model on the data from multiple partial differential equations (PDEs). However, adding heterogeneous PDEs with different governing equations, physical variables, and variable interactions does not always improve predictive performance across tasks. Existing PDE mixture-of-experts models mitigate cross-task interference through learned routing, but typically use homogeneous expert architectures, making it difficult to directly reflect differences in state evolution across equations. We introduce HotPOT, an operator transformer with heterogeneous physics experts for large-scale PDE pre-training. HotPOT uses a shared encoder to capture information common across PDEs, while each PDE family uses a neural-numerical expert that pairs a learnable predictor with a fixed numerical update containing no trainable parameters. Each predictor outputs the quantities required by its paired numerical update, which then computes the next state. This design allows different PDEs to share a common encoder while retaining their own learnable predictors and numerical updates. Experiments across five PDE families and six settings show that HotPOT outperforms MoE-POT in all 24 matched-scale comparisons before and after fine-tuning, reducing rollout error by 50.7% on average. Notably, the 17M model also surpasses substantially larger MoE-POT models, and the performance gains extend to zero-shot prediction under unseen physical conditions. Code is available at https://github.com/cruiseresearchgroup/HotPOT-code.

</details>


### [347] [Variational Consequence-Driven Offline Reinforcement Learning](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.38238)
*Wen Jiang,Ke Jiang,Xiaoyang Tan*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 论文提出结构化行为正则化，通过约束潜在空间中的散度来近似约束策略诱发的状态后果分布，从而提升离线强化学习对动力学变化的适应能力。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有离线强化学习方法通常约束学习策略与行为策略的动作分布差异，但动作分布相近并不代表状态转移一致。在对动作敏感的动力学区域，即使轻微偏离也可能引发显著不同的转移，使智能体离开离线数据覆盖范围。直接约束策略诱发的状态后果分布又因缺少真实动力学模型而难以计算。

Method: 提出结构化行为正则化，以闭式可计算的潜在散度替代难以处理的状态后果分布散度。通过构造能够反映转移动力学结构的潜在空间，使潜在散度成为真实后果分布散度的理论有界代理，并将其作为正则项加入策略学习。在动力学敏感区域，该约束会自适应收紧。

Result: 摘要报告称，该方法在多种离线强化学习基准上取得了优于现有方法的表现；未提供具体任务、指标或提升幅度。

Conclusion: 该研究将离线策略约束的重点从单纯匹配动作分布转向控制策略造成的状态后果，并以结构化潜在散度实现可计算的近似约束，有望更有效地防止策略偏离离线数据支持范围。

Abstract: Offline reinforcement learning (RL) typically mitigates distribution shift by imposing divergence constraints on the action distributions of the learned and behavior policies. However, this paradigm cannot ensure the underlying dynamic consistency structure: even minor action deviations can lead to drastically different transitions, inadvertently driving the agent away from the offline dataset. To address this, we explore policy constraints through their induced state-consequence distributions rather than relying on pure action-distribution matching. Nevertheless, directly enforcing such consequence-aware constraints is computationally intractable without access to the true underlying dynamics model. To bypass this issue, we propose Structural Behavior Regularization (StBR), which replaces the intractable objective with a closed-form latent divergence. Structuring this latent space to reflect transition dynamics renders the latent divergence a theoretically bounded surrogate for the true consequence-distribution divergence. By regularizing the learned policy with this latent divergence, StBR adaptively tightens the behavior constraint in dynamics-sensitive regions, effectively preventing deviations outside the offline dataset. Empirically, we demonstrate that StBR achieves superior performance across diverse offline RL benchmarks.

</details>


### [348] [Nearly Minimax Optimal Regret for Adversarial Linear Bandits with Strong Corruptions](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.38243)
*Qiwei Di,Quanquan Gu*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 论文提出一种适用于强腐蚀对抗性线性老虎机的新算法，在高概率意义下将遗憾上界降至与无腐蚀情形的最佳已知速率相匹配，并解决一般紧致动作集上的统计速率问题。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 强腐蚀对手能在观察到学习者动作后修改奖励。传统重要性加权估计对低概率动作的奖励极为敏感：对手只需在这些动作被抽中时施加腐蚀，就能将单位腐蚀的影响按抽样概率的倒数放大。此前最佳上界的主项比无腐蚀速率多出一个维度平方根因子；能否达到约为 d√T+dC 的遗憾上界，仍未解决。

Method: 提出基于跟随正则化领导者的算法，采用半径加权熵正则项，并用归一化核估计奖励，使腐蚀敏感度由各动作的半径控制，而非由抽样概率的倒数控制。算法将非递减半径与抽样分布联合确定，通过单调对数行列式障碍问题进行优化；正则项中的负线性项则用于抵消腐蚀偏差和各比较动作的估计误差。

Result: 对于位于 d 维空间中的 K 个动作，算法以高概率达到约为 √(dT log K)+dC 的遗憾上界（忽略对数因子）。将其应用于一般紧致动作集的离散化后，可得约为 d√T+dC 的遗憾上界。该结果在腐蚀项上与 Ω(dC) 的下界相符至对数因子，并将主项恢复到无腐蚀情形的最佳已知速率。

Conclusion: 该工作通过控制估计量对腐蚀的敏感度，克服了强腐蚀对重要性加权估计造成的放大效应，证明强腐蚀下仍可实现接近无腐蚀的统计遗憾速率，并解决了此前开放的遗憾界问题。

Abstract: We study adversarial linear bandits with strong corruption, in which an adaptive adversary chooses the reward vectors and a strong adversary corrupts each observed reward after seeing the learner's action, subject to a known total corruption budget $C$. Strong corruption breaks the importance-weighted reward estimates used by adversarial bandit algorithms: by corrupting only the rounds in which a rarely sampled action is drawn, the adversary amplifies each unit of corruption by the inverse of its sampling probability. The best known bound for this problem, $\tilde O(\sqrt{d^3T} + dC)$ by Liu et al. (2024), is a factor $\sqrt{d}$ above the corruption-free rate in its leading term, and whether $\tilde O(d\sqrt{T} + dC)$ regret is achievable was left open. We propose CRW-FTRL, which runs follow-the-regularized-leader with a radius-weighted entropy regularizer and estimates rewards with a normalized kernel estimator whose sensitivity to corruption is governed by per-action radii instead of inverse sampling probabilities. The radii are nondecreasing and are chosen jointly with the sampling distribution through a monotone log-determinant barrier problem, so that a negative linear term in the regularizer cancels both the corruption bias and the estimation error of every comparator. For $K$ actions in $\mathbb{R}^d$, CRW-FTRL achieves $\tilde O(\sqrt{dT\log K} + dC)$ regret with high probability against an adaptive adversary, which matches the best known corruption-free rate and the $Ω(dC)$ lower bound up to logarithmic factors. Applied to a discretization of a general compact action set, it yields $\tilde O(d\sqrt{T} + dC)$ regret, which settles the statistical rate of corrupted adversarial linear bandits under strong corruption.

</details>


### [349] [Transportable Offline Reinforcement Learning in Presence of Unmeasured Confounding](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.38253)
*Junyi Liao,Hangqi Ren,Zhuoran Yang*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 本文提出一种面向目标环境的离线策略学习框架，联合处理数据来源与目标环境的差异，以及未观测混杂因素；通过整合多个异质数据源进行因果识别，并据此优化策略。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 离线强化学习通常依赖历史数据，但数据收集环境可能与部署环境不同，且未记录的混杂因素可能同时影响历史行动与结果，导致直接学习的策略在目标环境中失效。多个来源各自可能无法单独完成因果识别，因此需要一种能够综合互补信息的理论与方法。

Method: 研究将可迁移性理论与工具变量、负向对照及代理变量结合，构建经因果调整的迁移框架，用于识别目标环境中的因果量。对于存在混杂的情境赌博机，识别问题可转化为桥函数积分方程组，并通过极小极大方法进行有限样本估计；再利用已识别量的置信集合进行悲观策略优化。该框架进一步扩展到分回合的混杂马尔可夫决策过程，在结构条件与完备性条件下利用互补数据源识别目标环境的奖励与转移机制；在高斯动力学和线性函数逼近设定下构造相应算法。

Result: 论文为两类问题给出了高概率有限样本次优性界，刻画逼近误差、估计误差、来源与目标环境差异、离线数据覆盖度及样本量的影响。对于有界有限维线性函数类，情境赌博机的保证达到通常的样本量负二分之一次方量级。数值实验支持该框架利用异质且存在混杂的数据学习目标环境策略的有效性。

Conclusion: 该研究为来源与目标环境存在差异且数据受到未观测混杂影响的离线策略学习提供了兼具因果识别与策略优化的统一方案。其核心价值在于整合多个互补数据源，使得即使没有任何单一数据源足以识别目标因果量，也仍可开展有理论保证的目标策略学习。

Abstract: Offline reinforcement learning seeks to learn decision policies from previously collected data, but deployment environments may differ from the domains in which the data were collected, and logged variables may omit confounders that affected both historical actions and outcomes. We study offline policy learning under the joint challenges of domain discrepancy and unmeasured confounding, where multiple heterogeneous source datasets provide complementary information about a target domain. We develop a causally adjusted transportability framework combining transportability theory with instrumental variables, negative controls, and proxies to identify target-domain causal quantities. For confounded contextual bandits, identification reduces to systems of bridge-function integral equations, enabling minimax estimation from finite samples. Confidence sets for the identified quantities are then used for pessimistic policy optimization, yielding CAT-CCB. We extend the framework to episodic confounded Markov decision processes, where complementary sources identify target reward and transition mechanisms under structural and completeness conditions. Under Gaussian dynamics and linear function approximation, this yields CAT-CMDP. We establish high-probability finite-sample suboptimality guarantees that quantify the effects of approximation, estimation, source-to-target shift, offline coverage, and sample size. For bounded finite-dimensional linear classes, the contextual-bandit guarantee recovers the standard $\widetilde{\mathcal O}(N^{-1/2})$ rate. Numerical experiments support the effectiveness of the framework for learning target-domain policies from heterogeneous confounded data. Together, the results provide a principled approach when no single source dataset suffices for causal identification and policy optimization.

</details>


### [350] [ParaTTT: Parallelizing Test-Time Training Layers with Deep Memories](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.38255)
*Noel Loo,Neehal Tumma,T. Konstantin Rusch,Mathias Lechner,Alexander Amini,Daniela Rus*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 论文提出 ParaTTT（PTTT），通过迭代细化隐藏层梯度轨迹，实现非线性测试时训练记忆的分块并行计算；两轮细化即可显著加速训练，并在语言建模与记忆能力上取得有竞争力的效果。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 测试时训练层以在线梯度下降训练的小型神经网络作为记忆，表达能力强于线性记忆，但现有方法依赖顺序的分块权重更新，速度较慢，而且只能近似逐词在线递推。论文旨在兼顾非线性记忆的表达能力与线性递推的高效并行性。

Method: 提出 ParaTTT，通过迭代估计内循环中的隐藏层梯度轨迹。每轮细化包含三次分块并行计算：前向计算特征轨迹；利用精确门控差分规则计算读出轨迹及其特征梯度；再通过反向传播更新梯度估计。精确的在线梯度下降递推是该迭代的一个不动点，推理阶段无需细化迭代。论文还证明，在满足收缩条件时，两层模型具有几何收敛性。

Result: 实践中两轮细化已足够。在四千词元上下文、误差相当的条件下，PTTT 计算内循环轨迹的速度比采用分块近似的 TTT-MLP 快三十二倍；三点四亿参数完整模型训练速度提升四点九倍。三点四亿及十三亿参数模型的语言模型困惑度和零样本准确率达到或超过 Gated DeltaNet 与 Mamba-2，并与同规模 Transformer 具有竞争力；在记忆召回方面优于线性递推模型。

Conclusion: ParaTTT 将非线性测试时训练记忆的在线更新转化为可高效分块并行的计算，并在少量迭代下接近精确递推。实验显示，该方法显著提升训练效率，同时保留非线性记忆的表达与召回优势，为构建高效、具备强记忆能力的递归架构提供了新路径。

Abstract: Test-time training (TTT) layers replace the linear fast-weight memory of modern recurrent architectures with a small neural network trained online by gradient descent. This nonlinear memory is more expressive than the linear memories of Gated DeltaNet and Mamba-2, but is difficult to parallelize: existing implementations such as TTT-MLP rely on sequential, block-wise weight updates that run several times slower than chunkwise-parallel linear recurrences. Moreover, their block-wise execution only approximates the token-by-token online recurrence, whereas linear recurrences admit an exact chunkwise-parallel evaluation. We introduce ParaTTT (PTTT), an algorithm for parallelizing arbitrarily deep nonlinear memories by iteratively refining estimates of the inner-loop gradient trajectory. Starting from a guess of the hidden-layer gradients, each refinement consists of three chunkwise-parallel passes: a forward pass that evaluates the resulting feature trajectory, an exact gated-delta-rule pass that computes the readout trajectory and its feature gradients, and a backward pass that propagates these gradients into a new estimate. The exact online gradient descent recurrence is a fixed point of the iteration, while decoding requires no refinement iterations. We prove geometric convergence for a two-layer variant under sufficient contraction conditions. In practice, two iterations suffice. With two refinement steps at 4K context, PTTT evaluates the inner-loop trajectory $32\times$ faster than TTT-MLP with the block approximation at matched error, while the full 340M model trains $4.9\times$ faster. Models trained at 340M and 1.3B parameters match or exceed Gated DeltaNet and Mamba-2 and remain competitive with same-size Transformers on language-modeling perplexity and zero-shot accuracy, with better recall than the linear recurrences.

</details>


### [351] [A Hybrid Physics-informed holomorphic neural networks Method](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.38269)
*Zhijie Su,Qiaolin He,Zhiping Mao,Shiquan Zhang*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 该方法将谱方法与全纯神经网络结合，用于求解复杂区域上的非齐次偏微分方程；在所测试的问题中，精度和训练效率通常优于标准物理信息神经网络。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 全纯神经网络可借助复解析表示，在构造上满足齐次偏微分方程，但直接扩展到非齐次问题并不容易。与此同时，复杂几何区域会增加传统数值方法的网格处理负担，因此需要兼顾非齐次源项处理、几何适应性与计算效率的方案。

Method: 将解分解为特解与齐次解两部分：在简单的扩展区域上用谱方法计算特解；再将特解对边界条件的影响纳入修正后的边界数据，仅依据边界数据训练全纯神经网络来近似齐次部分。两部分相加得到原问题的解，从而避免对复杂几何区域进行网格剖分，并保留全纯表示降低问题维度的优势。

Result: 该框架应用于非齐次泊松方程、斯托克斯方程、双调和方程、线弹性方程和亥姆霍兹方程。数值实验涵盖复杂几何、角点奇异性及近不可压缩情形；在所考察的测试中，方法能够准确求解，并且通常比标准物理信息神经网络误差更低、训练时间更短。

Conclusion: 将谱方法计算特解与全纯神经网络逼近齐次解相结合，为复杂区域上的非齐次偏微分方程提供了一种有效方案。摘要所述实验支持其精度与效率优势，但结论范围限于已测试的问题和情形。

Abstract: Physics-informed holomorphic neural networks (PIHNNs) exploit complex-analytic representations to satisfy homogeneous PDEs by construction, but their extension to nonhomogeneous problems is nontrivial. We propose a hybrid physics-informed holomorphic neural network (HPIHNN) framework based on a decomposition of the solution into particular and homogeneous components. The particular component is computed by a spectral method on a simple extended domain, while the homogeneous component is approximated by a PIHNN trained only on the boundary with modified boundary data. The resulting formulation avoids meshing complex geometries and retains the dimensionality-reduction advantage of holomorphic representations. The method is applied to nonhomogeneous Poisson, Stokes, biharmonic, linear elasticity, and Helmholtz equations. Numerical experiments covering complex geometries, corner singularities, and nearly incompressible regimes demonstrate that the proposed method accurately resolves the corresponding solutions and, in the considered tests, generally achieves lower errors and shorter training times than standard PINNs. The results indicate that coupling spectral particular solutions with holomorphic neural approximations provides an efficient approach to nonhomogeneous PDEs on complex domains.

</details>


### [352] [NAGO: Noise-Aware Generative Operator via Flow Matching](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.38273)
*Guanyu Chen,Shengze Xu,Pengwei Liu,Xingyu Ren,Pengkai Wang,Antonios Armaou,Tieyong Zeng,Dong Ni*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 论文提出一种噪声感知生成算子，通过针对性设计生成过程的源分布，使随机偏微分方程不变测度的采样更准确、更高效。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有函数空间生成流通常默认采用高斯源分布，但该选择未必适合目标随机场，可能造成边缘速度场的谱刚性，增加数值积分与采样成本。论文因此将源分布视为可设计变量，并研究其选择对无限维流的适定性和采样效率的影响。

Method: 作者先给出生成流在无限维函数空间中定义良好的可容许条件，并证明有限频带内源分布与目标分布的协方差比会控制边缘速度场的谱刚性。基于此，提出受可容许性约束的谱匹配策略：先确保源分布足够粗糙，以满足适定性要求，再在已解析的傅里叶模态上尽量缩小协方差差异。

Result: 在三个具有代表性的随机场基准上，该源分布设计提升了少步采样的谱精度，并改善了多项分布统计量与物理统计量。在受控的马特恩场消融实验中，相较高斯函数流匹配，达到准确结果所需的四阶龙格—库塔积分步数从约三十步降至三至五步，神经常微分方程函数评估次数减少约六至十倍。收益在平稳多尺度场上最明显，但会受到评价指标、分辨率和引导方案影响。

Conclusion: 论文表明，源分布并非只能采用默认高斯形式；在满足无限维适定性的前提下，依据目标场的谱结构匹配源分布，可以显著提高生成采样效率与精度。不过，这种收益具有任务与评估设置依赖性，应用时需结合具体场景进行设计。

Abstract: We introduce NAGO, a noise-aware generative operator for efficient sampling from invariant measures of stochastic partial differential equations (SPDEs) in function space. Our central idea is to treat the source measure as a design variable rather than a fixed Gaussian default. We establish admissibility conditions for well-defined infinite-dimensional flows and show that the finite-band source--target covariance ratio controls the spectral stiffness of the marginal velocity field. This analysis yields an admissibility-constrained spectral-matching rule: choose a source that is sufficiently rough for well-posedness, then minimize covariance mismatch over the resolved Fourier modes. On three representative stochastic-field benchmarks, this source design improves few-step spectral accuracy and several complementary distributional and physical statistics. In a controlled Matern-field ablation, it reduces the accurate RK4 budget from about 30 steps for Gaussian functional flow matching to 3--5 steps, a $6$--$10\times$ reduction in neural ODE evaluations. These gains are strongest for stationary multiscale fields and depend on the metric, resolution, and guidance protocol.

</details>


### [353] [The Role of Quantization in Loss Spikes](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.38277)
*Zaiqian Chen,Aditya Somasundaram,Sophie Li,Sean McLeish,John Kirchenbauer,Tom Goldstein,Micah Goldblum*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 论文发现，有限精度误差会推动语言模型预训练后期出现突发性损失恶化；改用带动量的随机梯度下降优化输出头，可提升长时间训练的稳定性。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 预训练中的损失突增会浪费大量计算资源，甚至使原本正常的训练失败。论文聚焦一种较少被关注的现象：训练进行很久后才出现的末期发散，并探究其与语言模型输出头数值不稳定之间的关系。

Method: 作者分析训练过程中输出头的量化误差、输出对数值及损失变化，并考察数值精度对突发性发散的影响。在此基础上，提出将输出头的亚当权重衰减优化器替换为带动量的随机梯度下降；同时比较既有缓解方法与该方案对量化误差的影响。

Result: 末期损失突增之前，输出头的量化误差会迅速增长；降低数值精度会加速此类突增，提高精度则能增强稳定性。对输出头使用带动量的随机梯度下降，可以抑制输出对数值增长并改善长时间训练的稳定性。作者还发现，已有缓解方法及其方案均会降低量化误差。

Conclusion: 有限精度误差是长时间预训练中末期突发性发散的一个重要隐性诱因。抑制输出头的量化误差和数值增长，有助于提高训练稳定性；不同缓解方法的共同作用机制可能正与此有关。

Abstract: Loss spikes in language model pretraining can waste substantial compute and derail otherwise healthy training runs. A primary driver of these instabilities is the growth and divergence of output logits in the final language modeling (LM) head. In this work, we study a particularly costly form of this instability associated with output logit growth: delayed, terminal divergences that emerge only after prolonged training, which we call time-bomb spikes. We find that these instabilities are preceded by rapidly growing quantization error in the LM head, which eventually culminates in a loss spike. Crucially, reducing numerical precision accelerates time-bomb spikes, while increasing precision improves stability. We then propose a simple yet effective mitigation that replaces AdamW on the LM head with SGD with momentum, suppressing logit growth and improving stability over long training horizons. Finally, we find that existing mitigation techniques from the literature (along with our own) all reduce quantization error, suggesting a shared numerical mechanism behind their effectiveness. Together, our results identify finite precision error as a hidden driver of time-bomb spikes and show that suppressing this error is key to stable long-horizon pretraining.

</details>


### [354] [A Case Study of a Multi-Agent Kernel-Optimization Loop That Learns a New AI Accelerator](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.38329)
*Byonggon Chun*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 本文展示了一套面向陌生硬件与编程语言的智能体优化流程，在十二天内优化三个解码内核，最终相较官方基准取得九点二九三倍的几何平均加速。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 当前大型语言模型虽能为常见任务编写正确的库达内核，但面对架构陌生、资料稀少的加速器时，正确率和优化能力会显著下降。研究旨在探索智能体如何在硬件知识有限、设备资源稀缺且测量结果有噪声的条件下，持续学习并优化内核。

Method: 研究以富罗西艾人工智能公司的锐劲神经处理器为案例，构建基于智能体循环的优化流程。系统整理并核验编程领域专用语言的文档，使用微基准测试测量芯片特性，并记录编译器推导出的合法性规则；工具链变化后，重新检查相关知识。针对每个内核，系统通过按角色分工的搜索，在设计树中探索整体方案，并将有效的小幅修改累积到当前最佳版本。设备测试前先以低成本检查筛除候选方案；后期则要求候选方案在设备上与当前最佳版本进行多次对比，确认后才予以采纳。

Result: 流程在十二天内优化了杰玛四代一百二十亿参数模型的三个解码内核。最终相较官方基准达到九点二九三倍几何平均加速；每个内核的运行周期均在仅搬运其权重所需周期的一点二五倍以内。

Conclusion: 该案例表明，即使面对陌生且文档稀少的硬件与编程环境，智能体也能通过主动构建目标知识、分阶段筛选候选方案和严格验证性能，取得显著的内核优化效果。研究同时强调，在设备稀缺、测量嘈杂的情形下，低成本预筛与重复实测对于可靠决策至关重要。

Abstract: Frontier large language models write correct CUDA kernels for most single-operator benchmark tasks, yet their accuracy collapses on accelerators whose architecture and programming language they have rarely seen. We present a case study of an LLM agent loop built for such accelerators. Our example is the FuriosaAI RNGD NPU, programmed in a recent, sparsely documented Rust DSL, where the loop optimized three Gemma-4-12B decode kernels over 12 days on a shared, scarce device. The loop builds its own target knowledge: it writes and checks a summary of the DSL documentation, measures the chip with microbenchmarks, records compiler-derived legality rules, and revisits this knowledge when the toolchain changes, rechecking rules and measurements where it can. A role-based search over per-kernel Design Trees explores whole-kernel designs and accumulates small accepted changes in the best version of each kernel. Because device time is scarce and readings are noisy, cheap checks screen new designs before any device run, and late in the run a change was accepted only after repeated comparisons with the best kernel on the device. The final kernels reach a 9.293x geomean speedup over the official baseline, each within 1.25x of the cycles needed just to move its weights. Our prompts, profiler and acceptance test are available at https://github.com/bgchun-fs/multi-agent-kernel-gen-loop.

</details>


### [355] [Multi-Token Prediction Done Right](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.38331)
*Jayden Teoh*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 软多词元预测通过剔除多词元训练中的噪声梯度，仅保留有益的自蒸馏信号，在不增加参数和可测开销的情况下，全面改善训练与推理表现。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 标准多词元预测训练的交叉熵梯度包含一个低信噪比残差。该残差会干扰下一词元和多词元学习，且模型规模越大，干扰越明显；它还会掩盖有助于推测解码的有效自蒸馏信号。

Method: 研究者将多词元预测的交叉熵梯度精确分解为两部分：使多词元预测头靠近模型自身下一词元预测分布的克尔散度自蒸馏梯度，以及低信噪比残差。随后提出克尔散度梯度恢复技巧：在两个分布共享线性输出头时，通过直通式梯度路由组合交叉熵梯度，精确恢复克尔散度梯度。由此形成软多词元预测，只反向传播自蒸馏信号，并复用已有计算，无需构造词表规模的对数几率矩阵。

Result: 在一亿六千七百万至十二亿参数规模的实验中，软多词元预测相较标准方法在所有规模下均降低下一词元困惑度、加快推测解码并提高零样本准确率；从六亿八千九百万参数起，多词元困惑度也更低。十二亿参数模型经微调后，数学与代码推理能力更强。多数指标上，该方法与直接最小化克尔散度相当或更优，且没有可测的额外开销。

Conclusion: 软多词元预测以极低的实现成本消除了标准训练中的有害梯度残差，保留并强化有效自蒸馏信号。摘要中的实验表明，它能够稳定改善模型效果与推测解码效率，是一种无需增加参数、近乎无额外成本的多词元预测优化方案。

Abstract: Multi-Token Prediction (MTP) is now a common ingredient in language-model pre-training, as it improves downstream performance and enables faster inference through speculative decoding. We identify a flaw in standard MTP training, in which a residual component of the MTP gradient interferes with both next-token and multi-token learning, increasingly so with scale. Specifically, the MTP cross-entropy gradient can be decomposed exactly into a KL self-distillation term that pulls each MTP head toward the model's own next-token prediction (NTP) distribution and improves speculative decoding, and a residual that has a low signal-to-noise ratio and buries the useful KL signal. We introduce the KL gradient-recovery trick: when two distributions share a linear output head, the gradient of their KL divergence can be recovered exactly by combining their cross-entropy gradients through straight-through gradient routing. Unlike minimizing the KL directly, this trick requires no vocabulary-sized logit matrices and is compatible with standard fused cross-entropy kernels. This enables Soft Multi-Token Prediction (Soft-MTP), a one-line code change to MTP that removes the noisy residual and backpropagates only the KL self-distillation signal by reusing the existing NTP and MTP cross-entropy computations. Soft-MTP supports both DeepSeek- and Meta-style MTP, adds no parameters, and incurs no measurable overhead. From 167M to 1.2B parameters, Soft-MTP improves over standard MTP with lower NTP perplexity, faster speculative decoding and higher zero-shot accuracy at every scale, lower MTP perplexity from 689M onward, and stronger math and code reasoning after fine-tuning at 1.2B. Soft-MTP also matches, if not exceeds, direct KL divergence minimization on most metrics. Soft-MTP is, in effect, a free lunch for MTP optimization. Our code can be found at https://github.com/JaydenTeoh/Soft-MTP.

</details>


### [356] [MUSE: Multi-Level Memory with Selective Runtime Injection for Scientific Coding Agents](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.38332)
*Haoran Jin,Defu Lian,Xiting Wang,Hong Xie*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 论文提出一种面向科学编程智能体的分层记忆框架，并在执行过程中有选择地注入相关经验；实验表明，该方法优于多种基线。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 历史经验可帮助科学编程，但仅在任务开始时检索经验，可能无法覆盖执行过程中才显现的实现细节与问题。因此，智能体需要既能利用不同层次的记忆，也能根据当前交互动态获取相关经验。

Method: 框架从历史执行轨迹中构建全局、方法层和实现层三种记忆。任务初始化时，向智能体提供全局记忆及与问题匹配的方法层记忆；执行期间，则依据当前交互检索实现层记忆，并由大语言模型判断是否注入相关经验。若选择注入，模型还会生成具体的审查建议；若无相关内容，则跳过注入。

Result: 在涵盖数值问题求解、计算内核优化和科学软件修复的四项基准测试中，该框架在所有评估指标上均优于检索方法和记忆基线。消融实验支持分层记忆设计与门控注入的有效性；迁移实验则显示，记忆在不同计算内核基准之间仍具有实用价值。

Conclusion: 研究结果表明，将多层次经验记忆与执行期间的选择性注入相结合，有助于科学编程智能体有效复用历史经验，并提升其在多类任务中的表现。

Abstract: Historical experience can guide scientific coding at multiple levels, but task-level retrieval may miss implementation lessons that become relevant during execution. We introduce MUSE, a memory management framework combining multi-level memory with selective runtime injection for scientific coding agents. MUSE builds global, approach-level, and implementation-level memory from historical trajectories. At initialization, the agent receives global memory and problem-matched approach-level memory. During execution, current interactions are used to retrieve implementation-level memory. An LLM gate selects relevant experience and generates specific review advice, or skips injection. Across four benchmarks spanning numerical problem solving, kernel optimization, and scientific software repair, MUSE outperforms retrieval and memory baselines on all evaluation metrics. Ablations support the multi-level design and gated injection, while transfer experiments show that memory remains useful across kernel benchmarks. These results show that multi-level memory and selective runtime injection enable effective reuse of experience in scientific coding. Code is available at https://github.com/hr-jin/MUSE.

</details>


### [357] [Optimal Regret for Communication-Efficient Decentralized Online Learning](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.38334)
*Sifan Yang,Wenhao Yang,Wei Jiang,Yuanyu Wan,Lijun Zhang*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 论文提出一种结合在线压缩与切比雪夫递推的快速一致性方法，并据此设计分布式在线算法，使凸损失和强凸损失下的遗憾界在主要参数上达到下界量级。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 在压缩通信的分布式在线凸优化中，现有遗憾上界对通信矩阵谱隙倒数的依赖过强，与相应下界存在多项式差距。论文旨在缩小这一差距，同时降低通信受限网络中的优化代价。

Method: 首先提出一种结合在线压缩策略与切比雪夫递推的群播一致性方法，以加快压缩条件下的共识收敛。随后将该方法用于分布式在线算法，使网络中的多个学习者仅依靠本地损失和邻居传来的压缩消息，共同优化逐步到来的全局损失序列。

Result: 对于凸损失，算法的遗憾上界为约 Ō(ω⁻¹ᐟ² nρ⁻¹ᐟ⁴√T)；对于强凸损失，上界为约 Ō(ω⁻¹ nρ⁻¹ᐟ² ln T)。除关于学习者数量和谱隙的对数因子外，这些结果在时间、网络规模、谱隙和压缩质量方面均与对应下界匹配。

Conclusion: 通过改进压缩通信下的一致性速度，论文消除了既有遗憾界对谱隙参数依赖过强的问题，并在对数因子范围内实现了理论最优的遗憾保证。

Abstract: In this paper, we investigate decentralized online convex optimization with compressed communication, where $n$ learners over a network jointly minimize a sequence of global loss functions based only on their local losses and compressed messages from their neighbors. The best known regret bounds for this problem are $O(ω^{-1/2}nρ^{-1}\sqrt{T\ln n})$ and $O(ω^{-1}nρ^{-2}\ln n\ln T)$ for convex and strongly convex loss functions, respectively, where $ρ\in(0,1)$ is the spectral gap of the communication matrix and $ω\in(0,1]$ is the compression quality factor. Compared with the corresponding lower bounds of $Ω(ω^{-1/2}nρ^{-1/4}\sqrt{T})$ and $Ω(ω^{-1}nρ^{-1/2}\ln T)$, these upper bounds exhibit polynomial gaps in their dependence on $ρ^{-1}$. To close these gaps, we first develop Ascent-gossip, which combines an online compression strategy with a Chebyshev recursion and attains a faster consensus rate than existing compressed gossip methods. Furthermore, by adopting Ascent-gossip, we propose an online algorithm that achieves optimal regret bounds of $\widetilde O(ω^{-1/2}nρ^{-1/4}\sqrt{T})$ and $\widetilde O(ω^{-1}nρ^{-1/2}\ln T)$ for convex and strongly convex loss functions, respectively. Up to logarithmic factors in $n$ and $ρ^{-1}$, these results match the lower bounds in terms of $T$, $n$, $ρ$, and $ω$.

</details>


### [358] [Learning a Prior-Data Fitted Network for Graph Foundation Models via Structural Causal Model Priors](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.38335)
*Ziwei Zhang,Tianyin Liao,Chunyu Hu,Ge Lan,Nuo Xu,Yi Huang,Qingyun Sun,Xingxuan Zhang,Peng Cui,Jianxin Li*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 论文提出一种基于结构因果模型先验数据拟合网络的图基础模型，通过合成图预训练，在不使用真实图数据预训练的情况下提升多领域图任务表现。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有图基础模型常受预训练规模有限或依赖大型语言模型文本对齐的限制。已有基于先验数据拟合网络的图模型，则难以刻画节点与边之间及其内部的因果关系，也难以生成多样图结构并有效学习复杂合成数据。

Method: 作者构建联合建模节点特征、图结构与标签的结构因果模型，用其生成合成图并表示节点和边之间的因果依赖；设计先验引导的节点—边依赖机制以生成多样图结构，并从理论上证明该生成先验比既有先验具有更强表达能力；同时提出对特征置换不变的双路径图网络，并给出其学习多样合成图的理论保证。

Result: 在二十三个真实世界基准上的实验显示，该方法优于传统图基础模型及基于先验数据拟合网络的图基础模型，且预训练未使用真实世界图数据。

Conclusion: 研究表明，将结构因果模型用于合成图先验，有助于统一刻画节点、边与标签的因果关系，并支持更具表达力的图生成和迁移学习。该方法为不依赖真实图预训练数据的通用图表示学习提供了一条可行路径。

Abstract: Graph Foundation Models (GFMs) have recently emerged as a promising paradigm for learning transferable representations across different graphs and domains. However, existing GFMs face notable limitations, including limited pre-training scale or reliance on aligning with textual information in Large Language Models (LLMs). To overcome these limitations, recent studies have drawn inspiration from prior-data fitted networks (PFNs), which learn from large synthetic datasets and support multi-domain prediction backed by causal learning. However, existing graph PFNs encounter severe difficulties in modeling causal relationships within and across node and edge sets, generating diverse graph structures, and designing suitable architectures that can learn from complex synthetic datasets. To address these challenges, we propose **GSCM-PFN** (Graph SCM-based Prior-Data Fitted Network), a graph PFN pre-trained on synthetic data generated from an SCM-based prior that jointly models nodes and graph topology. Specifically, we (1) design a joint feature-edge-label structural causal model (SCM) to guide synthetic graph generation and capture causal relationships within and across node and edge sets; (2) introduce prior-guided node-edge dependency modeling to instantiate diverse graph generation strategies, and prove that our SCM-based generation prior is more expressive than existing priors; and (3) propose a feature-permutation-invariant dual-path graph network with theoretical guarantees for learning from diverse synthetic graphs. Experiments on 23 real-world benchmarks show that GSCM-PFN outperforms both conventional GFMs and PFN-based GFMs, without utilizing real-world graph data for pre-training. Code: https://anonymous.4open.science/r/GSCM-PFN-A3A3/

</details>


### [359] [How Much Do Teacher Bridges Matter in Interleaved On-Policy Distillation?](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.38383)
*Leran Chen,Zhiyuan Yao,Lingnan Kong*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 研究比较了教师文本片段在在线策略蒸馏中的三种训练方式。短程训练与脑浮点推理下，未发现其带来明确的准确率提升；但结果不足以证明教师文本监督普遍无用。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 在线策略蒸馏通常利用学生自己生成的回答，并依据教师模型的预测训练学生。有些方法还会插入教师写出的文本片段，但对于这些片段应不应参与损失计算、以及如何计算，尚无一致结论。研究旨在控制生成轨迹相同，直接比较不同处理方式的影响。

Method: 以通义千问系列的十七亿参数模型作为学生、四十亿参数指令模型作为教师，在相同轨迹上比较不计算教师片段损失、使用正向散度损失和反向散度损失三种方案，并按文本由学生还是教师生成来区分梯度。研究还测试了将教师片段放在学生首段之后，以及在分歧较大的位置插入片段、加大其损失权重等设置；同时考察固定回答训练与在线训练，并分别使用脑浮点和单精度浮点推理进行评估。

Result: 主要比较中，教师片段仅占全部词元的百分之二点七，其梯度较小，且与学生生成词元的梯度近乎正交。三种损失处理的梯度方向相近，准确率在正负五个百分点的预设等效范围内没有显著差异。探索性试验曾提示，在学生失败回答与教师分歧最大的地方加入片段并训练可能有益，但预先设计的重复试验未能证实这一点，损失权重提高至四倍也未带来显著准确率提升。固定回答训练的收益在四次更新后达到峰值，之后学生逐渐难以停止生成；所测在线训练方案均未同时实现稳定停止与准确率提升。单精度评估中，重复试验模型常生成至回答长度上限。

Conclusion: 在本研究的短程训练和脑浮点推理条件下，未观察到教师文本作为上下文或训练目标带来额外准确率收益。不过，推理精度、训练步数及停止生成能力限制了结论的适用范围；因此，这些结果不能证明教师词元监督在一般情况下没有价值。

Abstract: On-policy distillation (OPD) trains a student using teacher predictions on student-generated responses. Some methods insert teacher-written segments, or bridges, but disagree on how to train on those tokens. We compare no loss, forward KL and reverse KL on identical trajectories using Qwen3-1.7B as student and Qwen3-4B-Instruct-2507 as teacher. We separate gradients by which model wrote each token. Under our short training runs and BF16 inference, pre-specified tests detected no added accuracy benefit from teacher text as context or as a training target. A one-paragraph bridge after the student's first paragraph is only 2.7% of the tokens and contributes a small gradient nearly orthogonal to the student-token gradient. In this main comparison, the three loss treatments gave similar gradient directions and were statistically equivalent in accuracy within a +/-5 percentage-point margin. An exploratory pilot placing the bridge where failed responses disagreed most with the teacher suggested a benefit from teacher-token loss. A pre-specified replication did not confirm this, and fourfold weighting showed no significant accuracy benefit. Two limitations bound these findings. Among the tested amounts of training on fixed responses, gains peaked after four updates before the student increasingly failed to stop generating. None of the tested online training variants met the criteria for stable stopping and improved accuracy. Our evaluations used BF16 inference, which rounds away most of the small weight changes. When evaluated in exact FP32, the tested replication models frequently reached the response-length limit. Our accuracy findings therefore concern BF16 inference; they do not establish that teacher-token supervision is generally unnecessary.

</details>


### [360] [Continual Adaptation Across Modalities: Learning and Forgetting in Unified Multimodal Models](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.38436)
*Xinrui Wang,Zhihao Chen,Jia Tang,Alexandra Gomez-Villa,Bartlomiej Twardowski,Joost van de Weijer,Songcan Chen*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 论文研究统一多模态模型在跨任务持续学习中的学习与遗忘规律，发现参数隔离可减轻跨模态干扰，生成能力比理解能力更脆弱，且后训练获得的能力最容易遗忘。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 统一多模态模型能够在同一框架中处理和生成多种模态，但在跨模态、多任务持续学习时，模型如何学习新任务、遗忘旧能力，以及生成与理解能力之间如何相互影响，仍缺乏系统认识。

Method: 系统考察模型架构设计与适配方法如何影响模态内学习和跨模态干扰，重点分析不同程度的模态专属参数隔离，以及生成侧与理解侧在持续学习和遗忘中的表现差异。

Result: 研究得到三项发现：模态专属参数隔离程度越高，跨模态干扰越弱；模型内部存在不对称性，生成能力明显比理解能力脆弱；后训练阶段新增的能力最先被遗忘，例如个性化生成能力下降百分之八十四至九十，而预训练阶段已有的能力则保持稳定。

Conclusion: 参数隔离有助于缓解统一多模态模型持续学习中的跨模态干扰，但生成能力，尤其是后训练获得的生成能力，容易受到新任务学习的冲击。研究为理解此类模型的学习与遗忘机制提供了依据，也为构建能够持续演进的多模态模型奠定了基础。

Abstract: Unified multimodal models (UMMs), which can process and generate diverse modalities within a single framework, have recently emerged as a powerful paradigm. However, when these models undergo continual learning on multiple tasks across different modalities, their learning and forgetting dynamics remain poorly understood. In this paper, we systematically investigate how architectural design and adaptation method shape intra-modal learning and cross-modal interference between the generation and understanding sides. Specifically, we report three findings. First, the severity of cross-modal interference decreases with the degree of modality-specific parameter isolation. Second, a within-model asymmetry: the generation side of a UMM is markedly more fragile than its understanding side. Third, what post-training adds is the first to be forgotten: purely post-training capabilities such as personalized generation collapse by 84\% to 90\%, while pretraining capabilities remain stable. Together, these results clarify how parameter isolation and post-training fragility shape UMMs' learning and forgetting dynamics, offering a starting point for developing continually evolving UMMs.

</details>


### [361] [AtomSteer: Test-Time Constraint Steering for Atomistic Generative Models](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.38517)
*Pengfei Cai,Katharina S. C. Jäger,Utkarsh Utkarsh,Nofit Segal,Bowen Deng,Akshay Subramanian,Rafael Gomez-Bombarelli*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 原子引导是一种无需重新训练的推理时约束方法，可提升晶体对称性、分子立体化学及蛋白质—配体结构的符合度，同时尽量保留预训练模型生成的结构特征。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 扩散模型和流匹配模型能够生成晶体、分子构象及蛋白质—配体复合物，但生成结果仍可能不满足晶体对称性、结构几何和立体化学要求。直接修正结构又可能破坏预训练模型已捕捉到的几何特征，因此需要一种在施加约束时尽量少改动其余结构的方法。

Method: 提出原子引导框架，在采样过程中对中间结构进行受约束修正：采用有界局部投影、基于图的刚性立体化学变换，以及周期对称性投影；仅接受能够改善约束满足程度、且限制结构其他部分变化的更新。该方法可用于多种现有预训练模型，无需重新训练或更改模型架构。

Result: 在三个预训练模型及多类任务上进行验证。在从头晶体生成中，该方法提升了空间群分布覆盖；在晶体结构预测中，提高了目标空间群恢复效果。分子构象生成方面，提升了分子有效性和顺反异构准确性，同时保留构象集合的真实性。蛋白质—配体复合物预测方面，相较实验参考结构减少了配体顺反异构错误，并保持有竞争力的对接成功率和结构有效性。

Conclusion: 原子引导为现有原子级生成模型提供了统一、免训练的推理时控制方案，能够增强化学与晶体学约束的满足程度，同时尽量保留模型原有的结构生成能力。

Abstract: Diffusion and flow matching models offer scalable approaches to generating crystalline materials, molecular conformers, and protein-ligand complexes. However, satisfying crystallographic symmetry, structural geometry, and accurate stereochemistry remains challenging. Satisfying these requirements calls for corrections that preserve the geometry already captured by the pretrained model. In this work, we propose AtomSteer, a test-time inference framework for steering pretrained atomistic generative models with structural constraints. During sampling, AtomSteer corrects intermediate structure predictions with bounded local projections, graph-rigid stereochemical transformations, and projections over periodic symmetries, accepting updates that improve constraint satisfaction while limiting changes to the rest of the structure. We demonstrate AtomSteer across three pretrained backbones, FlowMM, ET-Flow, and Boltz-2, spanning de novo crystal generation and crystal structure prediction, molecular conformer generation, and protein-ligand complex structure prediction. AtomSteer improves space-group distribution coverage in de novo crystal generation and improves target space-group recovery in crystal structure prediction. AtomSteer improves molecular validity and E/Z stereochemical accuracy while retaining conformer ensemble fidelity. For protein-ligand complexes, AtomSteer reduces ligand E/Z errors relative to experimental reference structures while achieving competitive docking success and PoseBusters validity. Our method provides a unified framework for adding chemical and crystallographic control to existing atomistic generative models without retraining or architectural changes.

</details>


### [362] [REVBRAIN: Real-time Probabilistic EEG Forecasting Using Residual Vector Quantization](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.38558)
*Hanna Pankka,Jaakko Lehtinen,Timo Roine*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 本文提出一种基于残差向量量化的脑电信号预测方法，可一次性生成整个预测区间，在预测精度更高的同时，实现实时推理，速度较现有深度学习方法提升超过五十倍。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 脑机接口中的脑状态依赖刺激等应用，需要实时预测持续进行的脑电振荡。现有深度学习预测方法虽比线性自回归模型准确，并能提供不确定性估计，但其逐样本自回归生成方式推理过慢，难以满足实时应用需求。

Method: 作者提出概率深度学习方法“反转脑”，通过残差向量量化将输出空间编码为离散词元，并在词元空间中直接生成整个预测区间的结果，从而避免逐样本反复调用模型。

Result: 在预测阿尔法频段（八至十三赫兹）两百毫秒脑电信号的实验中，该方法可在笔记本电脑的图形处理器上实时推理。与现有深度学习方法相比，其速度提升超过五十倍，预测准确度也更高。

Conclusion: 该方法兼具快速推理、较高预测准确度和概率预测能力，有望将准确的脑电预测应用于实时脑机接口，并为研究人脑功能提供新的工具。

Abstract: Real-time forecasting of resting-state EEG signals is required by applications like brain-state-dependent stimulation, where computer generated actions are coupled with ongoing neural oscillations. Recently, the deep learning model WaveNet was proposed for the forecasting task. It shows superior accuracy compared to the prevailing method, the linear autoregressive (AR) model, and provides a built-in uncertainty measure due to its probabilistic modeling framework. However, inference using WaveNet is too slow for real-time use due to its sample-by-sample autoregressive operation: a single forecast requires evaluating the model tens or hundreds of times depending on the length of the prediction window.
  In this paper, we present REVBRAIN, a probabilistic deep learning method that produces forecasts in real time by generating the forecast over the whole prediction horizon at once. This is achieved by tokenizing the output space using residual vector quantization (RVQ) and generating forecasts over the items in the tokenized space.
  We tested REVBRAIN for forecasting 200 ms of EEG time series in the alpha-frequency band (8-13 Hz) and compared our results against WaveNet model. We found that REVBRAIN achieved real-time inference on a laptop GPU and an over $50\times$ speedup compared to WaveNet, while reaching superior prediction accuracy.
  By achieving real-time inference speed, REVBRAIN enables incorporating accurate and probabilistic EEG forecasting into BCI applications, opening up new ways for investigating the functioning of the human brain.

</details>


### [363] [Persona Learning from Feedback for Personalized AI Assistants](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.38561)
*Yiran Shen,Yu Xia,Liuyi Yao,Prithviraj Ammanabrolu*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 论文提出一种基于反馈学习可复用助手人格的方法：在共享且冻结的基础模型上训练独立低秩适配器，并由路由器按请求选择适配器或固定组合。实验显示，该方法比固定人格策略及多种强基线更贴合偏好，同时保持通用能力。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 个性化助手需要根据用户偏好和任务情境调整回答。仅靠人格描述或基于人格生成内容进行微调，难以明确某个具体回答中应改变或保留哪些行为，也难以判断当前请求适合何种行为。因此，研究目标是利用针对具体回答的反馈，学习可复用、以偏好为依据的人格行为。

Method: 提出基于反馈的人格学习框架。在共享冻结的基础模型上，为不同人格训练相互独立的低秩适配器。训练时，冻结的自教师结合人格说明和针对回答的反馈，对适配器自身生成前缀提供逐词监督；反馈门控机制则把纠正更新集中到被判定需要改进的回答上。部署时，监督式路由器根据请求或对话选择单个适配器或预设的适配器组合，无需针对每位用户单独微调。

Result: 论文在两类任务中进行评估：使用模型生成评语的单轮个性化，以及依据模拟学生反应开展的多轮辅导。结果显示，该框架在模型评判的偏好契合度上优于固定人格策略，以及人格提示和人格蒸馏等强基线；同时未损害模型的通用能力。

Conclusion: 针对具体回答的反馈可用于训练可独立复用的人格行为，并通过路由机制适配不同请求与对话情境。该方法为无需用户专属微调的助手个性化提供了可行路径。

Abstract: Personalizing AI assistants requires adapting their behavior to users' preferences and task contexts. Existing work elicits assistant personas through persona prompting or finetuning on persona-conditioned generations. However, persona descriptions alone do not identify what to change or preserve in a particular response, or which behaviors suit the current request. We introduce $\textit{Persona Learning from Feedback (PLF)}$, a framework that learns reusable, preference-grounded assistant personas as independent LoRA adapters on a shared frozen backbone. During training, a frozen self-teacher conditions on persona specifications and response-specific feedback to provide token-level supervision on each adapter's own generated prefixes. A feedback gate focuses corrective updates on responses judged to need improvement. At deployment, a supervised router uses the request or dialogue to select a single adapter or a fixed composition, without user-specific finetuning. We evaluate PLF on single-turn personalization with model-generated critiques and multi-turn tutoring with simulated students' reactions. Across both settings, PLF improves model-judged preference fit over fixed-persona policies and strong baselines including persona prompting and persona distillation, demonstrating how feedback-trained behaviors can be reused for adaptive assistant personalization without degrading general capabilities.

</details>


### [364] [Episodic looking - using reinforcement learning to bias perception enhances few-shot and continual learning with protection from forgetting](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.38577)
*David Rawlinson,Gideon Kowadlo*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 论文借鉴互补学习系统，将快速记忆与稳健的长期表征分离，使模型既能记住近期输入，也能减少遗忘并改善少样本泛化。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 模型泛化能力与持续适应不断变化的输入统计特性之间存在矛盾。少样本学习和持续学习可能使已学表征产生偏置或受到干扰，进而削弱模型面对更广泛情境和输入变化时的表现。

Method: 构建互补学习系统：由短期记忆负责快速存储近期输入，并尽量避免不同记忆之间相互干扰；由变化较慢的长期记忆提供稳健、泛化的感知表征。短期记忆在长期记忆提供的表征空间中学习，从而将快速记忆与泛化能力相对分离。

Result: 在图像分类实验中，该模型在领域递增式持续学习任务中比仅使用残差网络长期记忆的基线更不易遗忘；在少样本任务中，其泛化能力优于其他持续学习方法。不过，其持续学习总体准确率略低于已有方法。

Conclusion: 将快速记忆与稳健表征分工，有助于兼顾近期输入记忆、抗遗忘和少样本泛化，但当前方法仍受长期记忆表征能力及其可塑性限制。未来可将短期记忆中的内容回放给长期记忆，以改善这一瓶颈。

Abstract: There is a fundamental contradiction between the desire for models that can generalize, and models that can continuously adapt to recent input with changing statistics. These conditions, captured in few-shot and continual learning settings, can bias or disrupt learned representations. This harms generalization to a broader context, leaving the model unable to overcome input variance.
  This paper proposes a solution based on the Complementary Learning System architecture (CLS), in which a Short-Term Memory (STM) delegates generalization to a slow, statistical Long-Term Memory (LTM). Delegation is achieved by working in a space of robust, generalized perceptions produced by the LTM. With this separation, the STM can focus on memorizing recent input and avoiding interference between memories.
  We show that on an image classification task, the resulting CLS model is more resistant to forgetting in a domain-incremental continual learning setting than a baseline ResNet LTM, and generalizes more effectively in a few-shot setting than other continual learners.
  In the continual setting, overall accuracy is slightly worse than existing continual learning models, but with a different mix of performance characteristics. Results analysis suggests that the model is limited by the representations and representational plasticity of the LTM. In future work, we will seek to address this by replaying STM memories to the LTM.
